detail.abstract:
This research paper is written by Kelvin Ho (Hong Kong Monetary Authority), Andrew Wong (Hong Kong Monetary Authority), and Vincent Lo (Hong Kong Institute for Monetary and Financial Research).

This study examines how global banks’ cross-border lending to high-emitting sectors is influenced by the stringency of climate policies in their home jurisdiction and their greenness commitment. Using a panel dataset of foreign bank branches in Hong Kong (FBHKs), we find that their aggregate exposure to high-emitting sectors has been stable. Although FBHKs from jurisdictions with stricter climate policies are found to have slightly higher average loan growth to high-emitting sectors as compared to other FBHKs, a further investigation using a granular borrower-level dataset reveals that their lending is primarily allocated to borrowers with a relatively lower emission intensity, suggesting a more selective approach to lending in high-emission sectors. Moreover, we find that FBHKs with a stronger greenness commitment, as indicated by their parent banks’ ESG scores, tend to have lower loan growth to high-emitting sectors when their home-jurisdiction climate policies tighten. The findings underscore the critical need for enhanced global coordination on climate policies, and more policies to promote a stronger commitment to environmental sustainability of the global banking sector.

detail.title: A Revisit to Estimating Phillips Curve and NAIRU in Pakistan

publicationDetails.detailsText: iRASD Journal of Economics, volume 6, issue 2, 2024[10.52131/joe.2024.0602.0211]

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the conventional Philips curve within the unique economic context of Pakistan, traditionally employed to analyze the intricate interplay between inflation and unemployment. Utilizing the Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) methodology, the research integrates annual data spanning from 1991 to 2022 on core inflation, unemployment, and supply shocks to estimate the Philips curve. Two distinct specifications of the Philips curve—the new Keynesian and the Triangle model—are employed to capture nuanced relationships. Moreover, the study establishes a constant Non-Accelerating Inflation Rate of Unemployment (NAIRU) derived from the estimated Philips curve, with precision assessed using Delta and Fieller methods. The empirical results robustly affirm the presence of a long-term trade-off between inflation and unemployment, offering fresh insights into Pakistan's economic dynamics. The ARDL error correction model reveals that shortterm inflation dynamics are primarily influenced by inertia. At the same time, long-term trends are dictated by unemployment and the import price index, with the industrial productivity index deemed insignificant. The calculated sacrifice ratios of 0.57 and 0.51, alongside NAIRU estimates of 5.7 and 5.0 for the New Keynesian and Triangular models, respectively, signal a need for caution in implementing anti-inflationary policies. Addressing the significant impact of demand gaps and supply shocks on inflation calls for policies to reduce supply-demand disparities. Maintaining an optimal equilibrium of inflation and unemployment (NAIRU) necessitates a combination of stabilization and adverse supply shock control policies. These findings underscore the stabilizing role of commercial policy and advocate for reforms to bolster Pakistan's industrial sector.

detail.abstract: We provide a number of insights into the nature and consequences of monopsony power through the lens of comparative advantage, where employers' power in wage setting stems from match-specific rents. Chief among them is that employers will apply larger wage markdowns to workers with greater comparative advantage at their firm. This leads to stronger monopsony power over more productive workers, provided the workers' comparative advantage aligns with their absolute advantage. Using Brazilian administrative data, we confirm this prediction: monopsony disproportionately affects high-wage workers within firms and workers at high-paying firms. The model, calibrated to our estimates for Brazil, predicts that minimum wages increase both wages and formal employment for more productive workers while pushing less productive workers out of formal employment.

detail.abstract:
This research paper is written by Shifu Jiang (Hong Kong Monetary Authority).

Can firms better finance investment to reduce their greenhouse gas emissions by setting decarbonisation targets? The answer depends on the content of their targets. Ambitious near-term targets may worsen stock performance and thus discourage investment at the very time when firms need to invest more to meet their targets. In contrast, the more comprehensive net-zero targets significantly improve stock performance while requiring little additional investment relative to that required by near-term targets. In both cases, firms tend to use internal financing rather than external equity or debt financing, suggesting barriers to transition finance that may delay firms’ efforts to decarbonize their activities.

title: Macroeconomic Determinants and the Kuznets Curve: Long-and Short-Run Impacts on Income Inequality in Malaysia

detail.title: Macroeconomic Determinants and the Kuznets Curve: Long-and Short-Run Impacts on Income Inequality in Malaysia

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses publicly available secondary data sources and did not involve human subjects. Ethical approval was therefore not required.

keywords: Cointegration Analysis and Error Correction Modelling

detail.abstract:
Purpose— This study investigates the long and short-run effects of macroeconomic factors on income inequality in Malaysia. Method-To analyze the relationship between the variables, cointegration analysis and error correction modeling are applied to data from 1991 to 2019. 

Findings— Economic factors have been shown to play a major role in long-term income inequality. However, the impacts of education, employment, and trade openness are not statistically significant on their own. Additionally, economic development initially leads to income disparity before leading to a more equitable income distribution after reaching a certain threshold. The research also highlights a negative relationship between productivity and income disparity. In the short term, all factors significantly affect income inequality, with short-term disruptions adjusting back to long-run equilibrium. 

Implications— The country's policy framework should prioritize the establishment of sustainable development strategies that ensure equitable income within society and promoting initiatives to improve labour productivity. Furthermore, regulatory measures must be strengthened to protect the well-being of people working in vulnerable jobs, which is critical in resolving the country's economic inequality. 

Originality— This research distinctively examine the non-linear impact of economic growth on income inequality. It is identified that after the economy reaches it's threshold point, income distribution will then be improved. Thus, it is proved that the influence of economic development on income inequality follows the Kuznets curve with an inverted-U shape.

detail.abstract: This paper analyzes the relationship between journalism, sociology, gender justice, and anti-tobacco movements on a global scale. The introduction explores key contexts in which the tobacco industry uses journalism and the media to target underserved people. The paper then proceeds to discuss specific strategies that these companies use to exploit gender and socioeconomic inequalities to maximize profits at the cost of public health. Throughout this process, the tobacco industry’s strategic media messaging campaigns weaken anti-tobacco regulations. This paper recommends conducting more monitoring of tobacco companies, drawing upon international resources, using economic strategies, and strengthening anti-tobacco media tactics. In turn, these efforts can help prevent vulnerable groups from being continually victimized by the tobacco industry.

detail.abstract: We study the interaction of climate policies and investments into fossil and renewable energy generation capacity under political uncertainty caused by democratic elections. We develop an overlapping generations model, where elected governments determine carbon taxation and green investment subsidies, and individuals make investments into fossil and renewable capacity. We find that some fossil investments become stranded assets if the party offering the higher carbon tax is unexpectedly elected. Green investment subsidies can be used by governments to bind the hands of their successor. By using the subsidy, the party in power can influence the capital stocks and, therefore, the climate policy of the following period to reduce or even avoid potentially stranded assets. With endogenous reelection probability, the impact on the capital stocks can also be used strategically to manipulate the reelection probabilities in favor of the party in power.

title: The Total Wave Modified Schrödinger Equation in Financial Prediction: Modeling Markets as Fields of Collapse
affiliations: Claremont Partners Pte. Ltd.

detail.title: The Total Wave Modified Schrödinger Equation in Financial Prediction: Modeling Markets as Fields of Collapse
detail.abstract: In physics, waves interfere, resonate, and collapse into outcomes. A photon does not choose its path until wave interference reaches a threshold. The Total Wave Modified Schrödinger Equation (TWMSE) formalizes this as a deterministic process, uniting collapse across electromagnetic, gravitational, and nuclear fields. Here we ask: what if financial markets behave the same way? Prices, volumes, and volatility are not random ticks, but waves colliding, resonating, and collapsing into observable moves. When we model markets as interference fields — inspired by physics — we find that predictable structure emerges. We build a Quantum Score, combining momentum, curvature, attention, phase coherence, and volatility coupling into a single signal. For each asset, we optimize three collapse conditions: buy threshold, sell threshold, and trailing stop. Testing on 30 US equities, our latest out-of-sample run (Aug 17, 2025) shows 26/30 positive Sharpe ratios (86.7%), median Sharpe 4.78, and median hit rate 71.1%. The results are not perfect, but they are more than chance. They suggest that markets may indeed echo the same collapse logic that governs the natural world. Finance is not apart from physics — it is another stage where waves play, collide, and become real.

AI.tldr: 该研究将量子物理中的波函数坍缩理论应用于金融市场，提出金融市场中的价格、交易量和波动率等指标类似于物理波，通过干涉、共振和坍缩形成可观测的市场变动。研究构建了量子评分信号，在30只美股测试中显示出86.7%的正夏普比率和71.1%的中位命中率。

detail.abstract:
This research paper is written by Kelvin Ho (Hong Kong Monetary Authority), Andrew Wong (Hong Kong Monetary Authority) and Vincent Lo (Hong Kong Institute for Monetary and Financial Research).

This study examines how global banks’ cross-border lending to high-emitting sectors is influenced by the stringency of climate policies in their home jurisdiction and their greenness commitment. Using a panel dataset of foreign bank branches in Hong Kong (FBHKs), we find that their aggregate exposure to high-emitting sectors has been stable. Although FBHKs from jurisdictions with stricter climate policies are found to have slightly higher average loan growth to high-emitting sectors as compared to other FBHKs, a further investigation using a granular borrower-level dataset reveals that their lending is primarily allocated to borrowers with a relatively lower emission intensity, suggesting a more selective approach to lending in high-emission sectors. Moreover, we find that FBHKs with a stronger greenness commitment, as indicated by their parent banks’ ESG scores, tend to have lower loan growth to high-emitting sectors when their home-jurisdiction climate policies tighten. The findings underscore the critical need for enhanced global coordination on climate policies, and more policies to promote a stronger commitment to environmental sustainability of the global banking sector.

AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证依据，强调需要加强全球气候政策协调和促进银行业环境承诺的政策措施，支持绿色金融发展

title: A Study on the Power Supply Subsidy Mechanism and Incentive Effects for V2g User Under Battery Depreciation Anxiety
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A Study on the Power Supply Subsidy Mechanism and Incentive Effects for V2g User Under Battery Depreciation Anxiety
detail.abstract: Addressing the adoption of Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) systems is crucial for mitigating renewable energy intermittency and enhancing grid flexibility. A tripartite game model involving the power grid, EV manufacturers, and V2G users is developed to compare electricity price subsidies and battery depreciation subsidies under users’ battery degradation concerns. The results indicate: (1) Battery depreciation subsidy is an effective incentive, while electricity price subsidy is largely ineffective. By directly alleviating battery degradation concerns, depreciation subsidy emerges as the optimal policy to promote V2G adoption and renewable integration. (2) Higher battery depreciation anxiety suppresses users’ willingness to participate, reducing transaction volumes, user net benefits, grid profits, and overall social welfare. (3) Combining electricity price and battery depreciation subsidies yields no additional benefit compared to depreciation subsidy alone. (4) Considering proportional electricity price subsidies or subsidy-empowerment linkage does not alter the fundamental conclusion—depreciation subsidy consistently demonstrates superior incentive effects. (5) Accounting for dynamic battery lifespan shows users respond more actively in early stages with sufficient lifespan but participation weakens as batteries age. These findings highlight the central role of battery depreciation subsidy in motivating EV users, supporting large-scale V2G promotion, and facilitating renewable energy integration.

AI.tldr: 电池折旧补贴比电价补贴更有效激励V2G系统采用，直接缓解用户电池衰减担忧是最优政策，组合补贴无额外收益，用户参与度随电池寿命衰减而下降
AI.research_question: 比较电价补贴和电池折旧补贴在用户电池衰减担忧下对V2G系统采用的激励效果
AI.motivation: 解决可再生能源间歇性问题，增强电网灵活性，促进V2G系统大规模应用
AI.theoretical_framework: 三方博弈模型（电网、电动汽车制造商、V2G用户），考虑电池衰减担忧的激励机制设计
AI.method: 构建三方博弈模型，分析不同补贴政策下的均衡结果，比较电价补贴和电池折旧补贴的效果
AI.findings: 1) 电池折旧补贴是有效激励，电价补贴基本无效；2) 电池衰减焦虑抑制用户参与意愿；3) 组合补贴无额外收益；4) 折旧补贴始终表现最优；5) 用户参与度随电池寿命衰减而下降
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了考虑电池衰减担忧的三方博弈理论框架，揭示了折旧补贴的激励机制优势
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证依据，建议优先采用电池折旧补贴政策来促进V2G大规模应用和可再生能源整合

reference: IZA Discussion Paper No. 18084
title: The Impact of Geopolitical Risk on Consumer Expectations and Spending
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley - Department of Economics, , European Central Bank (ECB) - Directorate General Research and University of Texas at Austin

detail.title: The Impact of Geopolitical Risk on Consumer Expectations and Spending

publicationDetails.detailsText: IZA Discussion Paper No. 18084
publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Using novel scenario-based survey questions that randomize the expected duration of the Russian invasion of Ukraine and Middle East conflict, we examine the causal impact of geopolitical risk on consumers' beliefs about aggregate economic conditions and their own financial outlook. Expecting a longer conflict leads European households to anticipate a worsening of the aggregate economy, with higher inflation, lower economic growth, and lower stock prices. They also perceive negative fiscal implications, anticipating higher government debt and higher taxes. Ultimately, households view the geopolitical conflict as making them worse off financially and it leads them to reduce their consumption.

AI.tldr: 通过普柬调查设计随机化中东和乌克兰冲突持续时间，研究发现地缘政治风险会导致欧洲家庭预期通胀和政府债务上升，经济增长和股市下降，最终减少消费支出
AI.research_question: 地缘政治风险对消费者对市场经济条件和个人财务前景的信念有何因果效应？
AI.motivation: 理解地缘政治冲突如俄乌战争和中东冲突对家庭经济决策的影响，以及这些冲突如何通过预期机制影响宏观经济
AI.theoretical_framework: 预期形成理论、地缘政治风险对经济活动影响、家庭消费决策理论
AI.method: 普柬调查方法，使用场景基础问卷随机化冲突持续时间，分析欧洲家庭的回答数据
AI.findings: 预期冲突持续时间更长会导致家庭预期通胀上升、经济增长下降、股市下跌；政府债务和税收增加；最终减少消费支出，认为自身财务状况恶化
AI.theory_contributions: 证实地缘政沘风险通过预期机制影响宏观经济，为地缘政治风险与家庭消费决策提供理论支撑
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府和政策制定者提供关于地缘政治冲突对消费者信心和经济预期影响的实证核据，有助于平息经济波动

title: Black-Litterman Portfolio Optimization Using Machine-Learning, Deep Learning and Reinforcement Learning Algorithms

detail.title: Black-Litterman Portfolio Optimization Using Machine-Learning, Deep Learning and Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
detail.abstract: A portfolio optimization plays a critical role in the financial world. Today the portfolio managers, financial and investment analysts, quantitative researchers from different financial institutions and companies try to find new or better approaches to optimize the investment portfolio in comparison with classical techniques. Nobel prized Harry Markowitz in 1952 introduced his world famous model which is still used by financial scientists in researches as a benchmark or as a background to develop new approaches. The model has some limitations in terms of data normality assumption, historical meanvariance approach instead of potential risks evaluation and others. As a result, some assumptions become irrelevant in real market conditions. Black-Litterman model developed by Fischer Black and Robert Litterman in 1992 attempts to handle some limitations of Markowitz model. This research project will use the Black-Litterman model as a background for further investigation. The view matrix construction will use the Machine Learning and Deep Learning models predictions. MLDL-based Black-Litterman model is expected to demonstrate higher cumulative returns and Sharp rations in comparison with classical Markowitz and BL models.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用机器学习和深度学习预测构建Black-Litterman模型的观点矩阵，预期相比传统Markowitz和BL模型能获得更高的累计收益和夏普比率。
AI.research_question: 如何利用机器学习和深度学习改进Black-Litterman模型的观点矩阵构建，以提升投资组合的绩效表现？
AI.motivation: Markowitz模型存在数据正态性假设和历史均值方差方法的局限性，Black-Litterman模型虽有所改进但仍需优化。机器学习方法能够提供更准确的市场预测，有望进一步提升投资组合优化效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Markowitz现代投资组合理论和Black-Litterman模型，结合机器学习和深度学习预测理论。
AI.method: 使用机器学习和深度学习模型预测构建Black-Litterman模型的观点矩阵，对比传统Markowitz和标准BL模型的绩效。
AI.findings: 预期MLDL-based Black-Litterman模型将展示更高的累计收益和夏普比率（研究结果待验证）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将机器学习和深度学习技术整合到传统投资组合理论中，为量化金融领域提供新的理论框架和方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资组合管理者提供基于人工智能的优化工具，有望在实际市场中获得更好的投资回报和风险调整后收益。

title: The Retreat from Causality: Local Projections and Econometrics Without Economics
affiliations: Bank of Korea Economic Research Institute

detail.title: The Retreat from Causality: Local Projections and Econometrics Without Economics
detail.abstract: This paper critically examines the local projections method introduced by Jordà (2005), questioning its validity in the absence of a well-defined causal framework. Although local projections have been widely adopted for their technical simplicity and perceived robustness, this study argues that such methods may obscure, rather than clarify, underlying causal mechanisms. At the heart of the critique is the method's neglect of the recursive and interdependent structure of the data-generating process, which results in logically inconsistent assumptions and potentially distorted forecasts.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性分析了Jordà(2005)提出的局部投影方法，质疑其在缺乏明确定义因果框架下的有效性。研究发现该方法忽视数据的递归和相互依赖结构，导致逻辑不一致的假设和扭曲的预测。
AI.research_question: 局部投影方法在缺乏明确定义因果框架的情况下是否有效？
AI.motivation: 尽管局部投影方法因技术简单性和感知鲁棒性而被广泛采用，但该方法可能掩盖而非阐明潜在的因果机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于因果推断理论和时间序列分析框架，强调数据生成过程的递归和相互依赖结构的重要性。
AI.method: 理论分析和批判性评估方法，对局部投影方法的基本假设和逻辑一致性进行检验。
AI.findings: 局部投影方法忽视数据生成过程的递归和相互依赖结构，导致逻辑不一致的假设和可能扭曲的预测结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 为时间序列因果分析方法提供了重要的理论警示，强调了明确定义因果框架的必要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒研究者在应用局部投影方法时需要谨慎，建议在明确因果框架下使用该方法以避免误导性结论。

title: Funding liquidity risk and risk-taking behavior of Japanese regional banks
affiliations: National Cheng Kung University - Graduate Institute of Finance and National Cheng Kung University

detail.title: Funding liquidity risk and risk-taking behavior of Japanese regional banks
detail.abstract: The Japanese banking culture differs from that of the West. This study examines how the funding liquidity risk affects the risk-taking behavior of Japanese regional banks (JRBs). The sample period is from 2004:H1 to 2022:H2, which spans the periods of the global financial crisis, the Bank of Japan’s negative interest rate policy, and the COVID-19 pandemic. The empirical results indicate that JRBs with lower funding liquidity risk tend to take more risk by making more loans. However, during the GFC, NIRP, and the COVID-19 pandemic periods, the positive association between liquidity and risk-taking is mitigated. This suggests that, during the distressed periods, bank managers were more conservative in making loans even if the funding liquidity risk was lower. Finally, we also find that the capital adequacy ratio exhibits the moderating effect between liquidity and risk-taking for JRBs, which suggests the capital requirement relief for JRBs by the Japanese regulators may induce more risk-taking.

AI.tldr: 日本地区银行资金流动性风险较低时更愿意提高风险承受水平，但在金融危机、负利率政策和疫情期间这种正相关关系被削弱，资本充足率起到调节作用。
AI.research_question: 资金流动性风险如何影响日本地区银行的风险承受行为？
AI.motivation: 日本银行业文化与西方存在差异，需要研究资金流动性风险对风险承受行为的特定影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 银行风险管理理论、流动性风险管理理论和风险承受行为理论。
AI.method: 实证分析，根据2004年上半年至2022年下半年的时间系列数据，涵盖全球金融危机、负利率政策和COVID-19疫情期间。
AI.findings: 资金流动性风险较低的日本地区银行更愿意提高风险承受水平（增加贷款），但在危机期间这种正相关关系被削弱，资本充足率对流动性与风险承受关系有调节作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了银行流动性风险管理理论，揭示了不同经济环境下流动性风险对风险承受行为的异质性影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为日本监管机构提供了政策建议，资本要求缓解可能导致地区银行增加风险承受，对于稳健金融系统具有重要意义。

title: Dress Codes, Human Rights, Professional Image, and Cultural Identity: A Critical Review with Special Reference to Indigenous and Climate-Appropriate Attire
affiliations: Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology

detail.title: Dress Codes, Human Rights, Professional Image, and Cultural Identity: A Critical Review with Special Reference to Indigenous and Climate-Appropriate Attire
detail.abstract: This article synthesizes socio-legal, anthropological, organizational, and building-science evidence to examine how dress codes shape-and are shaped by-human rights, professional image, and cultural identity. We show that attire powerfully in luences irst impressions and status attributions, yet formal codes often encode Eurocentric and gendered aesthetics that disadvantage religious, ethnic, and Indigenous minorities. Evidence linking clothing to performance is context-dependent: garments can shift cognition and leadership perceptions, but effects vary by task and meaning. In law and policy, dress rules intersect with equality, belief, and dignity, and overbroad "neutrality" mandates risk discriminatory outcomes. Thermal-comfort research further demonstrates that rigid Western formality is physiologically irrational and energy-inef icient in hot, humid climates. A Sri Lankan case study of Vedda attire highlights the need for principled cultural accommodation. We propose a "Tropical Professional" standard-outcome-based, climate-appropriate, and culturally inclusive-to align institutional aims with rights, culture, and decarbonization.

AI.tldr: 本文综合多学科证据，分析着装规范如何影响人权、职业形象和文化认同，提出基于结果、气候适宜和文化包容的"热带职业"标准
AI.research_question: 着装规范如何塑造并被人权、职业形象和文化认同所影响？
AI.motivation: 探讨正式着装规范中存在的欧洲中心主义和性别偏见对宗教、种族和原住民少数群体的不利影响，以及其在热湿气候下的生理不合理性
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会法律理论、人类学理论、组织行为学理论、建筑科学理论
AI.method: 多学科证据综合分析和斯里兰卡Vedda服饰案例研究
AI.findings: 服装显著影响第一印象和地位归因；正式规范常带有欧洲中心主义偏见；着装对绩效的影响具有情境依赖性；热舒适研究表明西方正式着装在热湿气候下生理不合理
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了着装规范与人权、文化认同和气候适应性的多维分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 提出"热带职业"标准，为机构提供兼顾权利保护、文化包容和脱碳目标的着装政策建议

title: Threshold Effects of Extreme Heat on Schooling and Child Labor in Rural Bangladesh
affiliations: Wilfrid Laurier University

detail.title: Threshold Effects of Extreme Heat on Schooling and Child Labor in Rural Bangladesh
detail.abstract: Identifying threshold effects of extreme heat is key to understanding the true scale of climate-related risks to human capital development. This paper investigates how extreme heat shapes adolescent schooling and labor outcomes in rural Bangladesh. I combine household survey data on adolescents with high-resolution temperature records to estimate the effects of prior-year, cumulative, and early-life heat exposure. I find evidence of strong threshold effects, with temperatures above 36°C sharply reducing school attendance and increasing child labor. These effects are disproportionately concentrated among girls, who are leaving school primarily to take on household responsibilities rather than to earn wages. Cumulative exposure to extreme heat amplifies these effects, highlighting their persistence and the limited scope for household adaptation. Extending the analysis to early-life conditions, I show that exposure during the first 1,000 days also reduces the probability of attending school in adolescence and negatively affects both girls and boys. Together, the findings point to two complementary mechanisms: immediate, income-mediated responses that reallocate adolescent time from school to work, and long-term developmental impacts of early-life heat exposure. The impact of extreme heat on schooling and child labor is highly non-linear, with little effect at moderate levels but sharp declines in school participation and shifts toward labor once critical temperatures are exceeded.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现极端高温对孟加拉农村青少年教育和劳动存在显著阈值效应，36°C以上温度会急剧降低入学率并增加童工现象，女孩受影响更严重，且早期生命暴露会产生长期发展影响。
AI.research_question: 极端高温如何影响孟加拉农村青少年的教育和劳动结果？
AI.motivation: 识别极端高温的阈值效应对于理解气候相关风险对人类资本发展的真实规模至关重要
AI.theoretical_framework: 阈值效应理论、人力资本发展理论、气候经济学
AI.method: 结合家庭调查数据和高温分辨率温度记录，估计前一年、累积和早期生命热暴露的影响
AI.findings: 发现强烈的阈值效应，36°C以上温度显著减少入学率和增加童工；女孩受影响更严重；累积暴露放大效应；早期生命暴露降低青春期入学概率
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了极端高温对人类资本发展的双重机制：即时收入调节反应和长期发展影响
AI.practical_contributions: 为气候政策制定提供了实证依据，特别关注弱势群体（女孩）的保护和适应性措施

reference: IZA Discussion Paper No. 18082
title: Local Public Goods and Property Tax Compliance: Experimental Evidence from Street Pavement
affiliations: Universidad de Los Andes, UC Berkeley and University of Exeter

detail.title: Local Public Goods and Property Tax Compliance: Experimental Evidence from Street Pavement

publicationDetails.detailsText: IZA Discussion Paper No. 18082
publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Developing countries often face a cycle where weak tax compliance limits public goods, cutting incentives to pay taxes. We test whether improved local infrastructure can disrupt this cycle, using a randomized street paving experiment in Acayucan, Mexico. Of 56 eligible street projects, 28 were randomly selected. A model highlights two mechanisms: belief updating about government efficiency and reciprocity from direct benefits. Three implications follow: (1) belief updating occurs through exposure to paving anywhere in the network; (2) compliance rises with broader exposure; (3) reciprocity boosts compliance among directly treated owners. Survey data supports belief updating: among initially dissatisfied residents, a one-SD increase in exposure to assigned paving lowered dissatisfaction by 7.9 pp, while exposure to actual paving lowered it by 8.8 pp, with no effect among the satisfied. Property tax records show exposure to assigned paving raised compliance by 1.5 pp, and to actual paving by 2.6 pp (3% above baseline). Reciprocity mattered too: owners whose street was assigned paving (or actually paved) increased compliance by 3.2 pp (4.8 pp, or 5.5% above baseline). Belief updating yields four times as much revenue as reciprocity.

AI.tldr: 本文通过墨西哥Acayucan的随机街道铺设实验，发现改善地方基础设施能够打破税收遵从的恶性循环。研究表明信念更新和互惠机制共同作用，其中信念更新通过接触任何铺设项目产生，而互惠机制仅影响直接受益者。信念更新产生的税收收入是互惠机制的四倍。
AI.research_question: 改善地方基础设施能否打破发展中国家税收遵从的恶性循环？具体通过什么机制发挥作用？
AI.motivation: 发展中国家普遍存在税收遵从度低导致公共产品供给不足，进而进一步降低纳税意愿的恶性循环。需要实证检验基础设施改善能否破解这一困境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于两个核心机制：信念更新机制（居民通过观察政府效率而更新对政府能力的信念）和互惠机制（直接受益者出于回报心理提高纳税意愿）
AI.method: 随机对照实验设计：在墨西哥Acayucan的56个符合条件的街道项目中，随机选择28个进行铺设。使用调查数据和财产税记录进行分析。
AI.findings: 1) 信念更新确实发生：接触铺设项目显著降低居民不满；2) 接触铺设项目提高税收遵从度1.5-2.6个百分点；3) 直接受益者的遵从度提高3.2-4.8个百分点；4) 信念更新产生的收入是互惠机制的四倍
AI.theory_contributions: 首次实证区分并量化了基础设施改善影响税收遵从的两个不同机制（信念更新vs互惠），揭示了信念更新机制的主导作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家破解税收恶性循环提供了实证依据，建议通过展示政府效能来广泛提升纳税意愿，而不仅仅是依赖直接受益者的回报心理

reference: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2025-111
title: Religion in Emerging and Developing Regions
affiliations: University of California, San Diego (UCSD), Boston University and University of Chicago

detail.title: Religion in Emerging and Developing Regions

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2025-111
publicationDetails.journalName: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines the evolving relationship between religion and economic development in emerging and developing countries (EDCs). Building on large-scale survey data and recent scholarship, we document persistent and, in many regions, increasing levels of religiosity. First, we present global trends in religious beliefs and practices, highlighting a religious divergence between EDCs and high-income countries, as well as the continued prevalence of traditional belief systems alongside major world religions. Second, we analyze the determinants and consequences of religious behavior, showing how income volatility, financial insecurity, and cultural transitions sustain demand for religion. Third, we explore the institutional and political dimensions of religion in EDCs, emphasizing the role of religious institutions as public goods providers and as politically influential actors. This discussion offers a framework for understanding religious organizations as adaptive, competing platforms in pluralistic religious marketplaces. Overall, our findings suggest that religious adaptation, rather than decline, is central to understanding the future of religion and its economic implications in the developing world.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了新兴和发展中国家宗教与经济发展的演变关系，发现宗教性水平持续且在许多地区增长，宗教适应而非衰退是理解发展中世界宗教未来的关键。

detail.abstract: Background: The rise of artificial intelligence (AI), including generative tools and large language models, is influencing how systematic literature reviews (SLRs) are conducted. Yet, existing practices remain fragmented, with little consensus on how best to integrate automation while maintaining transparency and methodological rigor. Methods: This study combines a systematic review with methodological framework development. We reviewed 53 peer-reviewed publications from 2023 to mid-2025 to examine how AI tools are being applied across six key stages of the SLR process: search, screening, data extraction, analysis, synthesis, and reporting. Using thematic synthesis and bibliometric mapping, we identified recurring challenges, methodological gaps, and emerging patterns in AI usage. Based on these insights, we developed SLRᴬᴵ-a seven-stage workflow that integrates AI tools with structured human involvement at each step. The framework was validated through comparison with existing literature, practical tool-task mapping, and feedback from 16 researchers participating in a faculty development program. Results: Findings highlight five major thematic clusters and four cross-cutting insights, underscoring the importance of human-in-the-loop oversight in ensuring accuracy, reproducibility, and ethical alignment. The proposed workflow addresses current limitations through modular design, transparent role allocation, and stage-wise validation. Implications: SLRᴬᴵ offers a practical approach for research teams seeking to improve review efficiency while upholding scholarly standards. Its structure supports both novice and experienced reviewers in diverse fields. Broader Relevance: This study contributes to the growing field of responsible automation in research synthesis, offering a scalable model for integrating AI tools without compromising academic integrity.

detail.abstract: Do religious beliefs affect responses to fertility incentives? We examine a 1982 maternity benefits expansion in Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania in a difference-in-differences framework with similar East European countries as comparisons. To isolate the importance of religion, we compare women who did and did not grow up in religious households when religion was formally outlawed, resulting in similar adult characteristics among women in the Baltics by importance of religion. Maternity benefits increased fertility only among women who grew up in religious families, providing novel evidence that cultural norms transmitted through the family can amplify the effects of public policies.

title: A Historical Analysis of Banking System Development in Islamic Countries
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: A Historical Analysis of Banking System Development in Islamic Countries
detail.abstract: The conventional narrative of banking system development in Islamic countries often presents a linear progression: colonial powers introduce modern banking to foster broad economic sectors, followed by post-independence nationalization and the creation of development banks to spur industrialization. This paper critically challenges this oversimplified account, arguing that colonial banking was primarily an instrument of imperial extraction, serving metropolitan interests rather than comprehensive indigenous development. Through detailed case studies of post-independence nationalization in Pakistan, Egypt, and Algeria, it reveals that these transformations, while driven by aspirations for economic sovereignty, frequently led to inefficiencies and were shaped by complex political and ideological imperatives. Furthermore, the research highlights the enduring legacy of sophisticated pre-colonial Islamic financial institutions and the emergence of modern Islamic banking, driven by distinct religious and economic factors, which disrupt any singular developmental trajectory. This paper offers a nuanced understanding that prioritizes historical accuracy and analytical depth, revealing a multi-faceted evolution far more intricate than commonly portrayed.

detail.abstract: Inequality of opportunity has great normative importance. This has led to a literature on measuring the part of overall inequality that is due to circumstances outside of a person's control. We contribute to such studies by evaluating the implications of uncertainty about circumstance variables and linear versus nonlinear transmission of circumstances on inequality of opportunity estimates. Applying linear Bayesian model averaging methods and three ensemble tree-based machine learning approaches to data from 31 European Union countries, we find that ignoring model uncertainty can lead to substantial overstatement of levels of inequality of opportunity.

detail.abstract: We enhance sentiment analysis in the foreign exchange (FX) market by fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) to better understand and interpret the complex language specific to FX markets. We build on existing methods by using state-of-the-art open source LLMs, fine-tuning them with labelled FX news articles and then comparing their performance against traditional approaches and alternative models. Furthermore, we tested these fine-tuned LLMs by creating investment strategies based on the sentiment they detect in FX analysis articles with the goal of demonstrating how well these strategies perform in real-world trading scenarios. Our findings indicate that the fine-tuned LLMs outperform the existing methods in terms of both the classification accuracy and trading performance, highlighting their potential for improving FX market sentiment analysis and investment decision-making.

detail.title: The Macroeconomic Effects of Agricultural Supply News
detail.abstract: Weather shocks are exogenous to the macroeconomy, but their market-wide effects are rarely isolated and studied empirically. Given its exposure and sensitivity to these shocks, the agriculture sector offers a useful source of such variation. We develop a new instrument based on market responses to confidential government crop reports, to measure their impact on the broader economy. Although it holds more sector-level explanatory power, our results indicate that a commodity news shock normalized to the impact of news about an upcoming poor harvest reduces domestic real GDP, industrial production, equity prices, grain exports, global oil production, the price of dry bulk shipping services, and the quantity of food-at-home consumed, while raising core CPI, stock market volatility, the price for U.S. field crop commodities, and food-at-home.

detail.abstract: I propose liquidity fees and buffers as a policy to stabilize stablecoins. Liquidity fees apply solely in the primary market and serve dual purposes: deterring panic withdrawals and replenishing reserves. Liquidity ratios, by contrast, directly limit redemption capacity and affect solvency perceptions. In a surprising result, an anticipatory behavior by arbitrageurs compresses arbitrage margins and lowers secondary market prices even before policies take effect, triggering ex-ante redemptions in the secondary market. Finally, stale pricing weakens arbitrage discipline, amplifying fragility. These results underscore the need to coordinate fee design and liquidity management to ensure stablecoin ecosystem resilience.

title: Speculation, Social Norms, and the Courts: A Case Study of Derivatives
affiliations: Charles III University of Madrid and University Carlos III of Madrid

detail.title: Speculation, Social Norms, and the Courts: A Case Study of Derivatives
detail.abstract:
Derivatives, in their most usual forms (options, forwards, and swaps) allow parties to hedge risks or speculate on the future value of assets, commodities, currencies, or indices. Their flexibility is staggering: they can be cash-settled or physically delivered, traded on exchanges or privately negotiated, and structured for purposes ranging from stabilizing agricultural prices to betting on interest rate fluctuations. Standardized documentation, like that provided by ISDA and similar frameworks, has introduced a level of certainty and predictability to these contracts. As a result, derivatives have come to be seen as a standard, and indispensable, form of contract in modern finance.

However, despite their widespread acceptance in both regulatory and contractual contexts, courts in European countries frequently face challenges concerning the validity and enforceability of derivatives. These courts struggle to establish clear criteria for distinguishing between legitimate and illegal transactions. In stark contrast with their standing in the market, challenges to derivatives are commonplace in the courts.

This paper argues that while regulation and market practices have helped normalize derivatives, deeper concerns about speculation, rooted in legal and social values, have not been fully addressed. These unresolved issues contribute to the difficulties courts face in developing a clear, balanced, and consistent approach. Part II considers the societal and institutional tensions over speculation which provide the foundation challenges to derivatives, and explores the impact of such tensions in legal policy and the neglected attention to the role of courts. Part III provides a comparative of past, present and emerging legal doctrines over the validity of derivatives contracts and its reflection of shifting societal norms over speculation. Part IV reviews regulatory and alternative dispute mechanisms launched in several jurisdictions and proposes they can complement, without replacing, judicial oversight over derivatives. Finally, Part V concludes by inviting a reflection on the law of derivatives, and courts’ role in it.

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于法律与社会价值观对投机的深层担忧理论，以及制度张力理论，分析衍生品合法性的社会规范变迁。
AI.method: 采用比较分析方法，研究过去、现在和新兴的法律原则，并进行多法域的监管和替代性争议解决机制比较研究。
AI.findings: 监管和市场实践虽然帮助衍生品规范化，但关于投机的深层法律和社会价值担忧未被充分解决，这导致法院难以形成清晰、平衡和一致的裁判方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了衍生品法律中法院角色的新视角，强调了司法监督在衍生品规制中的不可替代性，丰富了金融衍生品合法性的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法院提供处理衍生品案件的参考框架，建议监管和替代性争议解决机制可以作为司法监督的补充而非替代，为政策制定者提供改善衍生品法律环境的实践建议。

title: Tangled Up In Blue: The Police-elasticity of Crime Across Demographic and Socioeconomic Diversity
affiliations: Colorado College - Department of Economics and Business

detail.title: Tangled Up In Blue: The Police-elasticity of Crime Across Demographic and Socioeconomic Diversity
detail.abstract: Our work investigates how the responsiveness of crime to increased policing varies across diverse demographic and socioeconomic contexts. While prior studies often rely on models that assume homogeneity in the police-crime relationship, we argue that addressing contextual variation at the level of individual jurisdictions is critical. Using Uniform Crime Reporting (UCR) data for 224 U.S. jurisdictions over a 24-year period, we replicate and extend the work of Chalfin et al. (2022) by incorporating measures of population size and racial composition as important contextual determinants of police effectiveness. We present robust findings using crime levels, changes in crime rates, and per capita crime rates across a range of categories of crime. Our findings show that both population size and racial diversity significantly affect the way in which crime responds to changes in policing, with larger and more White-identifying cities seeing the potential deterring results of increased policing while smaller and more Blackidentifying cities actually associating increased policing with increased crime. Since police expenditures and hiring are primarily determined at the local level, this work has clear policy implications.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现警务资源增加对犯罪率的影响在不同人口统计和社会经济背景下存在显著差异，大城市和白人为主的城市中警务增加能有效威慑犯罪，而小城市和黑人为主的城市中警务增加反而与犯罪率上升相关。
AI.research_question: 警务资源增加对犯罪率的影响如何在不同人口统计和社会经济背景下变化？
AI.motivation: 先前研究通常假设警务与犯罪关系具有同质性，但需要关注个体司法管辖区的背景差异，因为警务支出和招聘主要在当地层面决定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于警务有效性的背景决定因素理论，重点关注人口规模和种族构成作为关键背景变量。
AI.method: 使用美国224个司法管辖区24年间的统一犯罪报告(UCR)数据，复制并扩展Chalfin等人(2022)的研究，纳入人口规模和种族构成作为背景变量。
AI.findings: 人口规模和种族多样性显著影响犯罪对警务变化的反应方式：较大且白人为主的城市中警务增加具有威慑效果，而较小且黑人为主的城市中警务增加反而与犯罪率上升相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了警务-犯罪关系同质性的假设，强调了背景因素在理解警务有效性中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为地方层面的警务支出和招聘决策提供明确的政策启示，建议根据不同城市特征制定差异化的警务策略。

title: Factors Influencing Interest Rates on Credit to MSMEs in Liberia
affiliations: Central Bank of Liberia

detail.title: Factors Influencing Interest Rates on Credit to MSMEs in Liberia
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the factors affecting interest rates on credit to micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) in Liberia, examining both demand-side and supply-side influences. I analyze credit provided by commercial banks, microfinance institutions (MFIs), and other lenders, drawing on empirical data from Liberia and comparative figures from Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA). The study integrates a literature review and relevant theoretical frameworks to explain why lending rates to MSMEs tend to be high. I find that interest rates in Liberia are influenced by a combination of high operational costs, credit risk premiums, and market structure on the supply side, as well as borrower characteristics and collateral constraints on the demand side. Comparative analysis indicates that Liberia's lending rates are broadly in line with other high-risk, low-income SSA economies, though higher than rates in more financially developed SSA countries. The paper concludes with a discussion of policy implications, highlighting the importance of improving credit information systems, reducing transaction costs, and enhancing the overall lending environment to lower the cost of credit for Liberian MSMEs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究利比里亚中小微企业贷款利率的影响因素，发现供给方的高运营成本、信用风险溢价和市场结构，以及需求方的借款人特征和抵押品约束共同导致高利率。利比里亚的利率水平与其他高风险、低收入撒哈拉以南非洲经济体基本一致。
AI.research_question: 影响利比里亚中小微企业贷款利率的因素有哪些？
AI.motivation: 探究为什么中小微企业贷款利率往往较高，特别是在利比里亚这样的发展中国家
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合供给方和需求方理论框架，分析贷款利率的决定因素
AI.method: 文献综述和实证数据分析，包括利比里亚和撒哈拉以南非洲地区的比较数据
AI.findings: 利比里亚贷款利率受供给方因素（高运营成本、信用风险溢价、市场结构）和需求方因素（借款人特征、抵押品约束）共同影响；利率水平与高风险低收入非洲经济体一致但高于金融发达地区
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了发展中国家中小微企业贷款利率决定因素的综合理论分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 提出改善信贷信息系统、降低交易成本、优化贷款环境等政策建议，以降低利比里亚中小微企业融资成本

title: The Impacts of Board's Unexpected Flood Experiences on Corporate ESG Performance
affiliations: Central University of Finance and Economics, Central University of Finance and Economics (CUFE) - School of Economics, Business School, National University of Singapore and National University of Singapore (NUS)

detail.title: The Impacts of Board's Unexpected Flood Experiences on Corporate ESG Performance
detail.abstract: This paper investigates how board members' unexpected flood experiences affect their firm's Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) performance. Using anonymized individual-level travel data from China during 2017-2022, we identify flood experiences of publicly listed companies' boards. Employing a staggered Difference-inDifferences design, we find that the firm's ESG rating increases by 2.43% (4.03%) eight quarters after the board's flood experiences during business (personal) trips. The effect is more pronounced when the floods are more severe and when the affected board member holds higher ownership stakes. We rule out alternative explanations such as disaster relief efforts. Beyond improved ESG ratings, we document greater managerial attention to environmental issues, as reflected in corporate disclosures, and a rise in firms' environmental performance projects. In addition, we provide evidence on the underlying value mechanism by showing that the ESG improvements are correlated with the costs and benefits of ESG improvements and the business exposure to flood risks. We also provide evidence on values mechanisms by showing that the ESG improvements are correlated with inherent personal characteristics such as gender.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过中国上市公司董事会成员的意外洪水经历研究了个人经验对企业ESG表现的影响，发现董事的洪水体验显著提升了企业ESG评分，并推动了环境管理具体行动。
AI.research_question: 董事会成员的意外洪水经历如何影响企业的ESG表现？
AI.motivation: 探索个人经验如何形成管理者对环境问题的关注度，以及这种关注如何转化为企业具体的ESG改善行动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学和管理者感知理论，重点关注个人经验对管理决策的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用隐私化的个人旅行数据，通过分步差分分差法(staggered Difference-in-Differences)识别董事洪水经历对企业ESG的影响。
AI.findings: 董事洪水经历使企业ESG评分提高4.03%（私人旅行）或2.43%（工作旅行），效果在洪水更严重、董事持股比例更高时更显著。企业环境更新和环保项目增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了管理者个人经验对企业策略决策影响的理论，提供了环境感知形成的微观机制证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业选择和培养具有环保意识的管理者提供实证支撑，为政府推动ESG发展提供政策启示。

title: The Impact of Household Responses to Housing Market Fluctuations on Wealth Inequality
affiliations: Bank of Korea Economic Research Institute, Bank of Korea and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Impact of Household Responses to Housing Market Fluctuations on Wealth Inequality
detail.abstract: Housing dominates Korean household assets, making market cycles pivotal for wealth distribution. While past downturns have temporarily reduced inequality, recent trends show that wealth disparities have widened despite housing price corrections. Using Korean household data, this paper analyzes how households respond to housing fluctuations through ownership retention, upgrading, and strategic transactions. Prolonged expansions, regional price polarization, and debt-leveraged upgrading by high-wealth households have intensified asset inequality. The housing price–debt link has strengthened, driven by both collateral effects and investment motives. These behaviors show that macroeconomic shocks have uneven, lasting impacts, highlighting the need for targeted housing and credit policies.

AI.tldr: 韩国房地产市场周期通过所有权保持、升级购买和策略性交易影响家庭资产分配，高资产家庭借贷升级行为加剧了资产不平等，需要针对性政策干预。
AI.research_question: 房地产市场波动如何影响韩国家庭的资产分配和不平等程度？
AI.motivation: 房产占韩国家庭资产的主要部分，市场周期对资产分配关键。过去下行周期会临时缩小不平等，但最近资产差距扩大而房价下调，需要探索其机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 房地产市场周期理论、资产分配理论、家庭财务决策理论
AI.method: 基于韩国家庭数据的实证分析，重点研究家庭在房价波动中的所有权保持、房屋升级和策略性交易行为
AI.findings: 长期价格扩张、地区价格两极化、高资产家庭借贷升级行为加剧了资产不平等；房价与债务联动性增强，由抵押品效应和投资动机驱动
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示宏观经济冲击对资产分配的不平等影响机制，丰富房地产市场与资产不平等的理论链接
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府制定针对性房地产和信贷政策提供实证支撑，帮助缓解资产不平等问题

title: When AI Sets Wages: Biases and Labor Discrimination in Generative Pricing
affiliations: Desautels Faculty of Management, McGill University, McGill University and McGill University - Desautels Faculty of Management

detail.title: When AI Sets Wages: Biases and Labor Discrimination in Generative Pricing
detail.abstract: We examine potential biases and discrimination in wage recommendations by analyzing how large language models (LLMs) assign hourly rates to online freelancers. Using 60,000 freelancer profiles from the top six categories in one of the leading online platforms, we prompt eight LLMs (GPT-4o, GPT o4-mini, Gemini 1.5 Flash, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, GPT-5 Mini, DeepSeek-R1, and Llama 3.1 405B), generating 480,000 price recommendations. Our analysis yields three key findings. First, LLMs systematically recommend higher rates than humans (mean human rate: $23.60; LLMs: $30.72-$45.77). Second, while no evidence of gender-based discrimination emerges, we observe substantial disparities by geography and age: geographic price gaps range from 19.5% to 130.4%, and age premiums reach up to 45.97%. Third, we test whether prompt interventions can mitigate these disparities. We find that geographic biases can be significantly mitigated through prompt design, while age-related disparities persist even under strong corrective instructions, suggesting that age-related biases are deeply embedded in the LLM training process. In total, our study generated approximately four million AI-generated price recommendations through API queries. We conclude by discussing the implications of these findings for labor markets, emphasizing that prompt design has clear implications for fairness and that regulatory oversight, including prompt transparency, may be warranted.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析大型语言模型在在线自由职业者时薪推荐中的偏见问题，发现LLMs系统性推荐更高费率，存在显著地理和年龄差异，提示干预可缓解地理偏见但年龄偏见难以消除
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型在在线自由职业者时薪推荐中是否存在偏见和歧视？
AI.motivation: 随着LLMs在劳动力市场中应用日益广泛，需要评估其推荐决策中的潜在偏见，以确保公平性
AI.theoretical_framework: 算法偏见理论、劳动力市场歧视理论、人机交互决策理论
AI.method: 使用60,000个自由职业者档案，测试8个主流LLM模型，生成480,000个价格推荐，分析地理、年龄和性别差异
AI.findings: 1. LLMs系统性推荐更高费率（$30.72-$45.77 vs 人类$23.60）；2. 存在显著地理差异（19.5%-130.4%）和年龄溢价（最高45.97%）；3. 提示干预可缓解地理偏见但年龄偏见持续存在
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了LLMs在劳动力市场推荐中的系统性偏见模式，特别是年龄偏见的顽固性，拓展了算法偏见理论的应用场景
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台设计公平的AI推荐系统提供实证依据，强调提示透明度和监管监督的重要性，为减少劳动力市场算法歧视提供实践指导

title: Impact of Natural Disaster on Child Marriage: The Case of the 2007 Cyclone in Bangladesh
affiliations: Linkoping University and Linkoping University - Department of Management and Engineering Division

detail.title: Impact of Natural Disaster on Child Marriage: The Case of the 2007 Cyclone in Bangladesh

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Authors have nothing to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The MICS survey obtained ethical clearance from the national ethics review authority and adhered to UNICEF’s Procedure for Ethical Standards in Research, Evaluation, Data Collection and Analysis. The data used for this study are anonymized and publicly available. No additional ethical approval was required for this secondary analysis.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Despite legal prohibitions, Bangladesh has one of the world's highest child marriage rates. While previous research has identified various drivers of child marriage, the causal impact of natural disasters remains poorly understood. This study provides the causal analysis of how environmental shocks affect child marriage by examining the 2007 Cyclone Sidr in Bangladesh. Using a difference-indifferences approach, we find that cyclone exposure dramatically increased child marriage rates across all age groups. The effects are largest for the youngest girls-cyclone exposure more than doubled marriage rates for girls under 14. These increases emerge approximately one year after the disaster, when families face prolonged economic hardship. Rural areas and severely affected regions experience the largest increases, suggesting that economic vulnerability drives families to use child marriage as a financial coping strategy. These findings highlight the need for extended social protection to prevent environmental shocks from reversing progress in child welfare.

AI.tldr: 本文通过双重差分法分析2007年孟加拉国飓风Sidr对童婚率的影响，发现自然灾害显著增加了各年龄段女孩的童婚率，特别是14岁以下女孩的童婚率翻倍，经济脆弱性是主要驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 环境冲击（自然灾害）如何因果影响童婚率？
AI.motivation: 尽管法律禁止，孟加拉国仍是全球童婚率最高的国家之一，但自然灾害对童婚的因果影响尚未得到充分理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经济脆弱性理论，自然灾害导致家庭经济困难，促使家庭将童婚作为财务应对策略。
AI.method: 采用双重差分法（Difference-in-Differences），分析2007年Cyclone Sidr飓风对童婚率的影响。
AI.findings: 飓风暴露显著提高了所有年龄段的童婚率，对14岁以下女孩的影响最大（童婚率翻倍）；效应在灾后一年出现，农村和重灾区增幅最大。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了自然灾害与童婚之间因果关系的实证证据，深化了对经济脆弱性驱动童婚机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调需要扩展社会保护计划，防止环境冲击逆转儿童福利进展，为政策制定提供依据。

title: The Impact and Prediction of Green Talents on China Economic Development
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Impact and Prediction of Green Talents on China Economic Development
detail.abstract: With China's economic and social development, the demographic dividend is accelerating its transformation into a talent dividend. Green talents have injected lasting impetus into sustainable economic development. This paper selects China's panel data from 2000 to 2021 as the research object and uses the principal component analysis method to deeply analyze the impact of green talents on China's economy. Through multiple linear regression analysis, it was found that there are five influencing factors that have a good predictive effect on China's GDP. They are Investment in the Treatment of Environmental Pollution, Total Energy Consumption, Undergraduates Number, Green Labor Force, and Gross Dependency Ratio.

AI.tldr: 本文通过主成分分析和多元线性回归，发现环境污染治理投资、能源消费总量、本科生数量、绿色劳动力和总抚养比对GDP有良好预测效果，验证了绿色人才对中国经济的积极影响。
AI.research_question: 绿色人才对中国经济发展的影响机制是什么？哪些因素对GDP具有显著预测作用？
AI.motivation: 随着中国经济社会发展，人口红利加速向人才红利转变，绿色人才为经济可持续发展注入持久动力，需要深入研究其影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人力资本理论和可持续发展理论，探讨绿色人才作为新型生产要素对经济增长的贡献机制。
AI.method: 使用2000-2021年中国面板数据，采用主成分分析法和多元线性回归分析方法进行实证研究。
AI.findings: 发现五个对GDP具有良好预测效果的影响因素：环境污染治理投资、能源消费总量、本科生数量、绿色劳动力、总抚养比。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了人力资本理论在绿色经济背景下的应用，拓展了人才红利向绿色人才红利转变的理论内涵。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府制定绿色人才政策和可持续发展战略提供实证依据，有助于推动经济高质量发展和生态文明建设。

title: Fair and Efficient Allocation of Indivisible Items under Category Constraints
affiliations: The University of Tokyo and Institut Polytechnique de Paris

detail.title: Fair and Efficient Allocation of Indivisible Items under Category Constraints

publicationDetails.detailsText: Games and Economic Behavior, Forthcoming;

detail.abstract: We study the problem of fairly allocating indivisible items under category constraints. Specifically, there are n agents and m indivisible items which are partitioned into categories with associated capacities. An allocation is considered feasible if each bundle satisfies the capacity constraints of its respective categories. For the case of two agents, Shoshan et al. (2023) recently developed a polynomial-time algorithm to find a Pareto-optimal allocation satisfying a relaxed version of envy-freeness, called EF[1,1]. In this paper, we extend the result of Shoshan et al. to n agents, proving the existence of a Pareto-optimal allocation where each agent can be made envy-free by reallocating at most n(n − 1) items. Furthermore, we present a polynomial-time algorithm to compute such an allocation when the number n of agents is constant.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在类别约束下公平分配不可分割物品的问题，提出了一个多项式时间算法来计算帕累托最优分配，其中每个代理最多通过重新分配n(n-1)个物品即可实现无嫉妒。
AI.research_question: 如何在类别约束下为n个代理找到帕累托最优且近似无嫉妒的公平分配方案？
AI.motivation: Shoshan等人(2023)针对两个代理的情况提出了多项式时间算法，但现实世界中往往涉及多个代理，需要将结果扩展到n个代理的情况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公平分配理论，特别是无嫉妒性(EF)和帕累托最优性，在类别容量约束的框架下进行研究。
AI.method: 理论证明存在性并设计多项式时间算法，当代理数量n为常数时算法有效。
AI.findings: 证明了存在帕累托最优分配，其中每个代理最多通过重新分配n(n-1)个物品即可实现无嫉妒状态。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Shoshan等人的两代理结果扩展到n代理情况，建立了更一般的理论框架。

title: The IS-IR Model: A Modern Macroeconomics Textbook Framework
affiliations: American University in Dubai

detail.title: The IS-IR Model: A Modern Macroeconomics Textbook Framework
detail.abstract: This paper proposes the IS-IR model as a modern alternative to the traditional IS-LM framework. The IS-LM model's premise of an exogenously controlled money supply and an endogenous interest rate fundamentally contradicts contemporary central banking, where policy rates are exogenously set and money creation is endogenous. Drawing on Post-Keynesian theory and empirical evidence, we argue the LM curve lacks theoretical and operational foundation. The IS-IR model retains the IS curve's goods-market logic but replaces the LM curve with a horizontal interest-rate (IR) schedule, reflecting the central bank's policy rate. This framework, incorporating endogenous credit spreads, o ers a more accurate and pedagogically sound tool for analyzing fiscal and monetary policy, financial shocks, and the zero lower bound.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IS-IR模型作为传统IS-LM框架的现代替代方案，认为LM曲线缺乏理论和操作基础，用水平利率曲线替代，更符合现代央行操作实践。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个更符合现代央行操作实践的宏观经济分析框架来替代传统的IS-LM模型？
AI.motivation: 传统IS-LM模型的外生货币供给和内生利率设定与现代央行外生设定政策利率、内生创造货币的操作实践存在根本矛盾。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于后凯恩斯主义理论，认为LM曲线缺乏理论和操作基础，主张用水平利率曲线（IR）替代。
AI.method: 理论构建和实证证据分析，提出IS-IR模型框架。
AI.findings: IS-IR模型保留了IS曲线的商品市场逻辑，但用反映央行政策利率的水平利率计划替代LM曲线，能够更准确地分析财政货币政策、金融冲击和零利率下限。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个理论上更一致的现代宏观经济分析框架，解决了传统IS-LM模型与现代央行实践的理论矛盾。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策分析和教学提供了更准确和教学上更合理的工具，特别适用于分析现代货币政策操作和金融稳定问题。

detail.abstract: This article examines the integration of Nikolai Kozyrev's theory of time into the homeokinetic approach for analyzing the dynamics of crime as an open system of interaction within the "criminal-victim-environment" triad. It demonstrates that time in this context acts not as a passive backdrop but as an active modulator of flows of matter, energy, and information that shape criminal events. The theoretical foundations, practical cases with statistical trends, and critical limitations of the approach are explored. New directions for research and preventive strategies are proposed, taking into account temporal dynamics.

detail.abstract: The accelerating energy transition, driven by decarbonisation goals and energy security concerns, is intensifying global lithium demand. This study evaluates the long-term adequacy and affordability of lithium supply by constructing a global bottom-up deposit database and generating a Cumulative Availability Curve (CAC) based on Estimated Recoverable Minerals and All-in Cost data. A six-step methodology incorporating Monte Carlo simulation and depletion curve analysis estimates 35.5 million metric tons of lithium content, with costs ranging from 1,194 to 26,332 USD per metric ton of lithium carbonate equivalent. While current supply is dominated by low-cost Australian ore, future production may rely more heavily on brine and unconventional sources. The comparison with IEA demand scenarios indicates that conservative supply assumptions could result in shortfalls, while meeting more ambitious climate targets may come at higher costs. These findings underscore the importance of timely investment in project development and recycling infrastructure to ensure a sustainable and affordable lithium supply.

detail.title: Differential Validity in Fair Lending

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2025-112
publicationDetails.journalName: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Fair lending’s disparate impact doctrine aims to address lending disparities. But which disparities? Traditional fair lending has narrowly focused on equal outcomes—examining differences in loan approval rates or interest rates. However, this singular focus overlooks other critical dimensions of disparities that are essential for fair credit access.  

This Article challenges the conventional emphasis on equal outcomes, demonstrating how it has failed to address deep-rooted inequalities in traditional credit allocation while also stifling innovation in machine-learning and alternative data. We argue that disparities in the validity of creditworthiness predictions —the accuracy with which a model identifies creditworthy applicants—severely impact equal access to credit and, in particular, the extension of credit to the creditworthy. Despite mounting empirical evidence of the harm of validity disparities, traditional fair lending enforcement inadequately recognizes this disparity dimension, a gap that may become increasingly harmful as lending decisions rely on advanced statistical methods. Future regulatory guidance, enforcement and supervision should explicitly recognize validity inequalities across protected groups while addressing the accompanying challenges of this more comprehensive perspective on disparities, which is essential for equitable credit allocation.

detail.abstract: Blockchain technology has become a disruptive force in the global financial sector, offering new ways to increase transparency, reduce costs, and build trust among stakeholders. This paper examines its potential applications in the marine finance sector which include ship financing, marine insurance, trade credit and port infrastructure investments. Despite the sector's vital role in global trade, marine finance remains hindered by inefficiencies, fragmented documentation systems and high transaction risks. This paper suggests that blockchain can help solve these issues by introducing smart contracts, asset tokenization and transparent ledgers for financing transactions. It also emphasizes how blockchain aligns with Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles to promote sustainable maritime investments. By combining insights from nautical science and international finance, this paper offers an interdisciplinary foundation for future research and policy debates on blockchain's role in marine finance.

affiliations: London School of Economics - Department of Finance and Faculty of Business and Economics, The University of Hong Kong

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence in the Boardroom
detail.abstract: We analyze how the use of artificial intelligence affects the monitoring and advisory relationship between CEOs and corporate boards. AI can serve as an advisor to CEOs, partially substituting for board advice, and thus reducing CEOs' incentives to share information with directors. In equilibrium, firms respond by reducing board independence to restore information flows. Lower monitoring intensity decreases CEO turnover, making CEOs more entrenched. Lower dismissal risk allows firms to reduce CEO compensation. We show that AI adoption by the board mitigates some of the negative aspects of the CEO's AI use, but cannot restore efficient levels of board monitoring. Our analysis suggests that the adoption of AI in the boardroom may have unintended consequences for corporate governance.

AI.tldr: AI作为CEO顾问会替代董事会建议，降低CEO信息分享意愿，导致企业降低董事会独立性来恢复信息流，这会减少CEO更替、增强CEO地位稳固性并降低薪酬。董事会采用AI可以缓解CEO使用AI的负面影响，但无法恢复有效的董事会监督水平。

title: Towards a Blunder-Free Society: A Game-Theoretic Framework for Optimizing Collective Outcomes Through Blunder Avoidance and Cooperative Strategies

detail.title: Towards a Blunder-Free Society: A Game-Theoretic Framework for Optimizing Collective Outcomes Through Blunder Avoidance and Cooperative Strategies
detail.abstract: This paper introduces a novel framework for conceptualizing the "best society" as one where complex thinking entities avoid blunders-knowingly suboptimal actionsthereby optimizing the impact of human actions on individual and collective life curves. Drawing from game theory, behavioral economics, and psychological metaphors, we redefine luck primarily as the externalities of others' blunders, with rare random hazards as negligible factors. Using the iterated Prisoner's Dilemma (IPD) as a core model, we demonstrate through simulations that strategies like tit-for-tat foster cooperation and maximize outcomes, proving that universal blunder avoidance leads to systemic trust and prosperity. Educational implications are discussed, advocating for curricula that teach blunder recognition to realize this ideal. Simulations confirm that blunder-free environments yield outcomes approaching optimal values (e.g., normalized O ≈ 0.6), supporting our hypothesis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个将'最佳社会'概念化为复杂思维实体避免失误的框架，通过博弈论和行为经济学证明避免失误能最大化人类行动对个体和集体生活曲线的影响，模拟显示无失误环境可实现接近最优的结果。
AI.research_question: 如何通过避免失误来构建最佳社会，以及失误避免如何优化人类行动的个体和集体影响？
AI.motivation: 重新定义社会最优状态的概念，强调通过避免明知次优的行动（失误）来提升社会整体福祉，而非依赖随机运气因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论（特别是迭代囚徒困境）、行为经济学、心理隐喻理论，将运气重新定义为他人失误的外部性。
AI.method: 使用迭代囚徒困境（IPD）作为核心模型进行计算机模拟，测试如以牙还牙等策略在促进合作和最大化结果方面的效果。
AI.findings: 模拟结果表明，以牙还牙等策略能有效促进合作，无失误环境可实现接近最优的结果（如标准化O≈0.6），支持普遍避免失误能带来系统信任和繁荣的假设。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将'最佳社会'重新概念化为失误避免框架的理论创新，重新定义了运气的概念，强调了系统性失误避免对社会优化的核心作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了教育课程改革建议，倡导教授失误识别技能，为实现理想社会提供实践路径，模拟结果为政策制定提供了实证依据。

title: The Rise of Distant Non-Bank Lending: Evidence from the Mortgage Market
affiliations: Australian National University (ANU), Australian National University (ANU) and Australian National University (ANU)

detail.title: The Rise of Distant Non-Bank Lending: Evidence from the Mortgage Market
detail.abstract: We document a dramatic rise in distant lending by non-banks that was triggered by the introduction of risk retention rules for asset backed securities. A carve out in the rules exempting agency securitizations and qualified residential mortgages (QRM) from risk retention led (non-fintech) non-banks to search afar for cheap-to-securitize loans once local markets are exhausted. Further, exempt non-bank loans, when made at distance, are more likely to foreclose than comparable distant loans made by banks: Consistent with non-banks arbitraging the definition of QRM and reducing the efficacy regulation. Finally, non-bank distant lending is positively associated with local real estate values.
