detail.title: The Optimal Schedules of Incentives and Cash Flows

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no relevant or material personal or financial interests that relate to the research described in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No patients/participants.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding received.

detail.abstract: We model delegated management when the agent can either invest in durable asset quality or instantaneous cash flows. Both actions add value, but the principal can only observe aggregate output, not the inputs or asset quality. Repeated incentives for short-term cash flows add up to incentives for asset quality. In a model without productive or cost complementarities, durable incentives are cheaper to provide despite the additional layer of adverse selection. The optimal contract begins with weak, back-loaded incentives and alternates between those and stronger, front-loaded incentives. Incentives become more intense and front-loaded after losses. The result is mean-reverting cash flows and a tight link between the schedule of incentives and the duration and autocorrelation of cash flows.

AI.tldr: 本文建模了委托管理情境，当代理人可以投资于持久资产质量或即时现金流时。两种行为都增加价值，但委托人只能观察总产出，无法观察投入或资产质量。重复的短期现金流激励累积形成资产质量激励。在没有生产或成本互补性的模型中，尽管存在额外的逆向选择层，提供持久激励的成本更低。最优合同从弱的后置激励开始，并在这些与更强的前置激励之间交替。损失后激励变得更强烈且前置。结果是均值回归的现金流，以及激励计划与现金流持续时间和自相关性之间的紧密联系。
AI.research_question: 在委托管理框架下，当代理人可以投资于持久资产质量或即时现金流时，如何设计最优激励合同？
AI.motivation: 现实中管理者需要在短期现金流和长期资产质量之间做出投资决策，但委托人只能观察到总产出而无法区分这两种投入，这导致了复杂的激励设计问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 委托-代理理论，信息不对称下的激励合同设计，重点关注代理人可选择的两种投资行为（持久资产质量 vs 即时现金流）及其可观察性约束。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建数学模型分析在委托人只能观察总产出的约束下，代理人投资决策的最优激励合同设计。
AI.findings: 1) 重复的短期现金流激励可以累积形成资产质量激励；2) 尽管存在逆向选择问题，提供持久激励的成本更低；3) 最优合同采用弱后置激励与强前置激励交替的模式；4) 损失后激励变得更强烈且前置；5) 导致均值回归的现金流模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了委托-代理理论在多重投资维度下的应用，提供了在只能观察总产出情况下设计激励合同的理论框架，揭示了短期激励如何转化为长期激励的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实际企业管理中的激励设计提供指导，特别是在需要平衡短期业绩和长期资产质量的情况下，提供了具体的合同设计原则和模式。

title: What do Women get from a Successful Revolution?
affiliations: Wabash College, Appalachian State University and Archbridge Institute

detail.title: What do Women get from a Successful Revolution?
detail.abstract: Our study investigates the impact of successful violent and nonviolent revolutions on post-revolutionary institutions concerning women. Leveraging the Nonviolent and Violent Campaigns and Outcomes (NAVCO) data on successful revolutions and the Varieties of Democracy dataset for gender-specific metrics, we employ fixed effect difference-in-differences and Callaway Sant'Anna. Our results show positive effects from both treatments. Nonviolent revolutions with regime change intentions have a more consistent positive impact on women's empowerment indices than violent revolutions, while revolutions without regime change intentions show mixed or limited effects across both violent and nonviolent cases.

AI.tldr: 非暴力革命特别是旨在政权更迭的革命，比暴力革命对女性赋权指数产生更一致的正向影响，而无意政权更迭的革命效果有限
AI.research_question: 成功暴力和非暴力革命对革命后女性相关制度的影响差异
AI.motivation: 探究不同类型革命对女性赋权的影响，为革命策略选择提供实证依据
AI.theoretical_framework: 革命类型学理论、女性赋权理论、制度变迁理论
AI.method: 固定效应双重差分法和Callaway Sant'Anna方法，使用NAVCO革命数据和V-Dem性别指标数据
AI.findings: 两种革命都有正向影响，但非暴力政权更迭革命对女性赋权的影响更一致且显著
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了革命类型与性别平等关系的理论框架，揭示了非暴力革命的制度优势
AI.practical_contributions: 为革命运动策略选择提供实证指导，强调非暴力政权更迭革命对女性赋权的积极影响

title: Marine Spatial Planning and Ecosystem Services in the Gulf of Guinea
affiliations: University of Buckingham

detail.title: Marine Spatial Planning and Ecosystem Services in the Gulf of Guinea
detail.abstract: Marine Spatial Planning (MSP) is an essential and critical process that plays a fundamental role in managing human activities in diverse marine environments, especially in areas rich in biodiversity such as the Gulf of Guinea. In recent years, there have been significant advancements in the field of MSP that emphasize the importance of integrating ecosystem services into the planning process. This integration is vital, as it enables sustainable development and aids in the protection of marine ecosystems, which are increasingly facing threats from various human activities. The successful implementation of MSP heavily relies on active and meaningful stakeholder engagement, rigorous scientific research, and the establishment of supportive policy frameworks. These components work together to foster collaborative and informed decision-making among all relevant parties (M. Reimer et al., 2023; Finke et al., 2020). By recognizing and incorporating ecosystem services as a core component of MSP, it becomes possible to manage marine resources more effectively and address pressing challenges such as climate change and the growing impact of human activities in these health-critical areas (M. Queirós et al., 2021). This holistic approach ensures that the diverse needs of both the environment and the communities that depend on these marine resources are balanced in a sustainable manner.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨海洋空间规划（MSP）中集成生态系统服务的重要性，尤其在几内亚湾等生物多样性丰富的海域。研究强调通过利益相关者参与、科学研究和政策支持来实现可持续发展和海洋生态保护。
AI.research_question: 如何通过将生态系统服务集成到海洋空间规划中，来更有效地管理海洋资源并应对气候变化和人类活动带来的挑战？
AI.motivation: 海洋生态系统面临着来自各种人类活动的严重威胁，而海洋空间规划作为关键管理过程，需要将生态系统服务组件纳入其中以实现可持续发展和生态保护。
AI.theoretical_framework: 海洋空间规划（MSP）理论、生态系统服务理论、可持续发展理论
AI.method: 文献综述和理论分析方法，基于现有研究成果和案例分析
AI.findings: 生态系统服务集成对MSP成功致关重要，需要利益相关者积极参与、严谨科学研究和支持性政策框架的支撑。这种整体方法能够平衡环境需求和社区利益。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了海洋空间规划理论，将生态系统服务理念系统性地融入MSP框架，为海洋可持续管理提供理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为几内亚湾等生物多样性海域的管理实践提供具体指南，提出通过利益相关者协作、科学研究和政策支持来实现可持续发展的实践路径。

title: Sustainable Futures: An Agenda For Action
affiliations: University of New Mexico - School of Law

detail.title: Sustainable Futures: An Agenda For Action
detail.abstract: In this sprawling monograph, Raphael Kaplinsky demonstrates that sustainability measures cannot be both practical and inspiring. Sustainable Futures: An Agenda for Action ambitiously attempts to span numerous social science disciplines with particular emphasis on environmental studies, sociology, and economic analytics. His thesis is that the issues of sustainability across these three areas are interlinked and structurally related to one another in ways that require them to be understood as such in order to effectively address sustainability going forward. The author thus attempts to lay out an integrated program spanning economic, social and environmental agendas which he asks governments as well as other stakeholders to participate in. Kaplinsky argues that the past several centuries have been punctuated by surges in economic growth which he terms techno-economic paradigms that reflect different ways of organizing production and society. He identifies four preceding paradigms: water power, steam power, iron/steel/steamships/telegraph, and mass production. Each of these flourished then passed into crisis, to be succeeded by a new paradigm. Kaplinsky hones in on the world’s environmental tension—humans have damaged our environment, and the environment is damaging us. These crises are in part a function of the decay of the most recent techno-economic paradigm, Mass Production. He pins his hopes on the emergence of a new paradigm he calls Information, Communications and Technology (“ICT”), which he suggests offers the potential for a more inclusive society, a more sustainable economy, and a more equal polity. At some points, the author’s approach may romanticize the past. For example, Kaplinsky suggests that after World War II, a relatively cohesive period of liberal democracy that he titles the Golden Age, transitioned after 1970 into the contemporary era of endemic conflict, culture wars, and the rise of populism. Perhaps the author’s argument is more nuanced than the reviewers observe.

AI.tldr: Kaplinsky认为可持续性措施无法同时具备实用性和启发性，提出需要将经济、社会和环境议程整合理解。他通过技术经济范式理论分析历史发展模式，认为当前大众生产范式正在衰退，寄希望于ICT新范式能带来更包容、可持续和平等的社会。
AI.research_question: 如何通过整合经济、社会和环境议程来有效解决可持续性问题？
AI.motivation: 过去几个世纪的经济增长模式（技术经济范式）导致了环境危机和社会问题，需要寻找新的发展范式来实现真正的可持续发展
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术经济范式理论，将历史发展划分为水动力、蒸汽动力、钢铁/蒸汽船/电报、大众生产四个范式，当前正在向ICT新范式过渡
AI.method: 跨学科综合分析，涵盖环境研究、社会学和经济分析，采用历史比较和范式转换分析
AI.findings: 可持续性问题在三个领域相互关联且结构相关，大众生产范式正在衰退，ICT新范式有潜力创造更包容、可持续和平等的社会
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了整合经济、社会和环境的三维可持续性分析框架，发展了技术经济范式理论在可持续性研究中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府和其他利益相关者提供了整合的行动议程，指出了向ICT范式转型的具体方向和可能性

title: Analyzing the Effect of Hurricane Irma on Birth Outcomes in Florida
affiliations: College of Saint Benedict and Saint John’s University, Cornell University, Florida International University (FIU) - Department of Economics and Boston University - School of Public Health

detail.title: Analyzing the Effect of Hurricane Irma on Birth Outcomes in Florida
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of Hurricane Irma on birth outcomes including low birth weight and preterm birth. In addition to psychological stress, Hurricane Irma may have affected the birth outcome through some other pathways including hurricane Irma-led evacuation of 7 million residents of Florida, knocking out power to 6.7 million utility customers, and damage in residential buildings. Following Currie and Rossin-Slater (2013), we examine whether stress induced by Hurricane Irma is the only casual role of birth outcome, or other aforementioned channels have also contributed to the outcome. We use cross-sectional birth records provided by the Florida Department of Health over the period 2016-2018 to explore the effect of hurricane Irma on birth outcomes through stress, and other related causal mechanisms mentioned earlier. To build the main model, the pregnant women stratified into treatment and control groups. Treatment group includes pregnant women living in the path of the hurricane and control group consists of those living away from the hurricane path. Using a difference-in-differences model, we capture the effect of hurricane exposure on the treated group before and after the hurricane. Also, geospatial information of Hurricane Irma such as the hurricane track and the wind speed were obtained from the Florida Division of Emergency Management and FEMA's HAZUS program. The results suggest that infants born in the path of Hurricane Irma were 6 grams lighter on average compared to infants born outside the hurricane path. The impact of the hurricane is larger in magnitude if pregnant women were exposed to the hurricane in their third trimester. Also, we found no impact of the hurricane exposure on the pregnant women's behaviors. We report some robustness checks and examine possible causal mechanisms that could contribute to the outcome.

AI.tldr: 本文研究飓风Irma对低出生体重和早产等出生结果的影响，通过双重差分模型发现飓风路径内出生的婴儿平均轻6克，且在孕晚期暴露影响更大。
AI.research_question: 飓风Irma引起的压力是否是影响出生结果的唯一原因，还是其他途径（如疏散、停电、建筑损坏）也起到了作用？
AI.motivation: 探究自然灾害（特别是飓风）对出生结果的影响机制，除了心理压力外是否还存在其他因果路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Currie和Rossin-Slater（2013）的研究框架，分析自然灾害通过多种渠道影响出生结果的理论机制。
AI.method: 使用2016-2018年佛罗里达州卫生部的横截面出生记录，采用双重差分模型，将孕妇分为飓风路径内的处理组和路径外的对照组。
AI.findings: 飓风路径内出生的婴儿平均轻6克；孕晚期暴露影响更大；未发现飓风暴露对孕妇行为有影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了自然灾害影响出生结果的理论机制，证实除了心理压力外，其他环境因素也起作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共卫生政策制定提供依据，帮助改善孕妇在自然灾害期间的防护措施和医疗支持。

title: A Finite Mixture Model for P-value Distributions under Publication Bias: EM-based Inference and Applications
affiliations: Sichuan University and Chengdu University of Traditional Chinese Medicine

detail.title: A Finite Mixture Model for P-value Distributions under Publication Bias: EM-based Inference and Applications

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patient data, or animal experiments, and therefore ethical approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Publication bias, referring to the preferential reporting, submission, and publication of statistically "significant" results, distorts null hypothesis significance testing (NHST) and meta-analytic evidence by inflating effect sizes, increasing false positives, and reducing replicability. When study inclusion depends on crossing a favored threshold (e.g., p < 0.05), the p-value distribution becomes a selection-biased mixture of null and non-null results. We propose an extended four-component finite mixture model that jointly captures null status and selection using only reported p-values. Unlike the traditional Beta(a, 1) alternative, a flexible Beta(a, b) distribution is employed to represent diverse right-skewed shapes. The four components-U(0, 1), U(0, α), Beta(a, b), and truncated Beta(a, b) over (0, α)-are estimated via a tailored Expectation-Maximization algorithm, with α learned from the data. We establish identifiability, outline asymptotic properties, and provide practical guidance, showing in simulations that the model accurately recovers mixture proportions, α, and Beta parameters, with potential extensions to multiple thresholds, covariate-dependent selection, and Bayesian regularization. All analysis code and replication materials are available at https://github.com/ljwa2323/pvalue-mixture-model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种扩展的四分量有限混合模型，仅使用报告的p值来联合捕获零状态和选择偏差，解决了传统Beta(a, 1)替代方法的局限性。
AI.research_question: 如何仅使用报告的p值来准确估计发表偏倚并恢复真实的效应量分布？
AI.motivation: 发表偏倚（偏好报告、提交和发表统计"显著"结果）扭曲了零假设显著性检验和元分析证据，夸大了效应量，增加了假阳性，降低了可重复性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 四分量有限混合模型：U(0, 1)表示真正的零结果，U(0, α)表示被截断的零结果，Beta(a, b)表示真正的非零结果，截断Beta(a, b)表示被截断的非零结果。
AI.method: 使用定制的期望最大化算法估计四个分量，α从数据中学习，建立了可识别性，概述了渐近性质，并提供了实用指导。
AI.findings: 模拟显示该模型能准确恢复混合比例、α和Beta参数，可扩展到多阈值、协变量依赖选择和贝叶斯正则化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个灵活的Beta(a, b)分布来代表多样化的右偏形状，克服了传统Beta(a, 1)替代方法的局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了完整的分析代码和复制材料，为研究者提供了实用的工具来检测和校正发表偏倚。

title: Computational Learning Mechanisms of Information Propagating in Social Networks
affiliations: , Dartmouth College - Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences, University of Cambridge - Faculty of Economics and Claude Bernard Lyon 1 University

detail.title: Computational Learning Mechanisms of Information Propagating in Social Networks
detail.abstract: What mechanisms underlie how individuals integrate disparate and redundant information that spreads in social networks? The DeGroot (DG) model suggests that we adjust our beliefs according to the weighted average opinions of our social connections. In contrast, reinforcement learning (RL) models assume that learning occurs sequentially, depending on error-driven belief updating. Here, we compare these models directly using two datasets of information propagating in social networks, and determine which learning rule best accounts for the integration of information spreading in social networks. We found that variants of the DG model provide a better overall fit across participants, and are more effective in building consensus, and generating accurate estimates of the true state of the world. Furthermore, simulated models show how social network topology affects choice accuracy and consensus, depending on the learning rule. Together, our findings characterize the computational mechanisms used by individuals to propagate information in social networks.

AI.tldr: 研究比较了DeGroot模型和强化学习模型在社交网络信息传播中的表现，发现DeGroot模型变体在整体拟合度、建立共识和准确估计真实状态方面更优，并揭示了社交网络拓扑结构如何影响学习规则的选择准确性和共识形成。
AI.research_question: 个体如何整合社交网络中传播的不同和冗余信息？DeGroot模型和强化学习模型哪种学习规则能更好地解释社交网络中的信息整合？
AI.motivation: 理解社交网络中信息传播的计算机制，比较不同学习模型在信息整合过程中的表现差异
AI.theoretical_framework: DeGroot模型（基于加权平均意见调整信念）和强化学习模型（基于错误驱动的顺序学习更新）
AI.method: 使用两个社交网络信息传播数据集直接比较两种模型，并进行模拟分析
AI.findings: DeGroot模型变体在参与者整体拟合度、建立共识和准确估计真实状态方面表现更好；社交网络拓扑结构影响学习规则的选择准确性和共识形成
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了社交网络中信息传播的计算机制，为理解个体如何整合网络信息提供了理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为社交网络中的信息传播策略设计提供了指导，有助于优化共识形成和准确信息估计

title: The Cantillon Effect on Digital Assets: A Praxeological Analysis of Cryptocurrency Distribution

detail.title: The Cantillon Effect on Digital Assets: A Praxeological Analysis of Cryptocurrency Distribution

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper did not involve human participants, animals or data needing ethical approval
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding

detail.abstract: The Cantillon Effect, first articulated in 1755, describes how new money enters an economy at specific points, disproportionately benefiting early recipients while later participants bear inflationary consequences. This paper examines how the Cantillon Effect manifests in cryptocurrency markets, challenging the notion that digital assets offer a departure from traditional monetary distortions. By applying a praxeological framework, the study explores how various cryptocurrency issuance mechanisms, including mining, staking, airdrops, and Initial Coin Offerings (ICOs), distribute wealth unevenly, creating privileged financial classes. The research further highlights how early adopters, venture capitalists, and insiders leverage information asymmetry to accumulate disproportionate influence over governance structures, reinforcing centralized power within supposedly decentralized systems. This paper draws on Austrian economic theory and argues that while cryptocurrencies present innovative financial models, their wealth distribution mechanisms replicate historic monetary distortions. The paper concludes with a discussion on market-based solutions to mitigate these distortions while preserving decentralization.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了坎蒂隆效应在加密货币市场的表现，挑战了数字资产能够摆脱传统货币扭曲的观点。研究发现加密货币的各种发行机制（挖矿、质押、空投、ICO）都会导致财富不平等分配，早期采用者、风险投资家和内部人士利用信息不对称积累不成比例的影响力，在去中心化系统中强化了中心化权力。
AI.research_question: 坎蒂隆效应如何在加密货币市场中体现？加密货币是否真的能够摆脱传统货币体系的财富分配扭曲？
AI.motivation: 加密货币常被宣传为能够避免传统货币体系的不平等问题，但实际运行中是否真的实现了更公平的财富分配需要深入研究。理解加密货币市场中的坎蒂隆效应对于评估其真正的去中心化程度和公平性具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 奥地利经济学理论，特别是坎蒂隆效应理论；行动学（praxeological）分析框架
AI.method: 理论分析框架应用，对加密货币各种发行机制（挖矿、质押、空投、ICO）的财富分配效应进行系统性分析
AI.findings: 加密货币的各种发行机制都会产生类似于传统货币体系的财富分配扭曲；早期参与者、内部人士和风险投资家通过信息不对称获得不成比例的利益；去中心化系统中出现了新的中心化权力结构
AI.theory_contributions: 将坎蒂隆效应理论扩展到加密货币领域；揭示了加密货币市场中新的财富分配机制和权力结构；为理解数字资产的经济学特性提供了新的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为加密货币投资者和政策制定者提供了关于市场不平等性的重要见解；提出了基于市场的解决方案来减轻财富分配扭曲；对加密货币项目的治理结构设计具有实践指导意义

title: Mainstreaming Cross-Border Arbitration At The Eacj: Role Of Intellectual Property In Regional Integration
affiliations: University of Nairobi School of Law and University of Nairobi

detail.title: Mainstreaming Cross-Border Arbitration At The Eacj: Role Of Intellectual Property In Regional Integration

publicationDetails.detailsText: Ordinary Issue, East African Law Journal  (EALJ), 2024, 89-112

detail.abstract:
Although the East African Court of Justice (EACJ) has arbitral jurisdiction over international commercial disputes, little to no attention has been paid to how this jurisdiction can be effectively harnessed for the resolution of cross-border intellectual property (IP) disputes among East African Community (EAC) member states. This paper acknowledges and appreciates that various communities in the EAC bloc share cultural values, practices and beliefs which constitute shared indigenous knowledge as an intellectual property right. While EAC countries like Kenya have legislation on IP including the Kenyan Traditional Knowledge and Cultural Expressions Act, 2016, these laws fail to sufficiently address how to resolve disputes that emerge outside the national territorial jurisdiction. Further, there are no uniform criteria for determining issues like cross-border access and benefit sharing (A&BS), promoting sustainable development, social equity and cultural diversity which may pose challenges when citizens of EAC member states seek redress for any infringement of individual or collectively owned IP rights.

 A casual view of EACJ’s Reports demonstrates the untapped potential of the EACJ as a regional adjudicator of cross-border disputes. On the one hand, it may be hypothesized that EAC member states prefer and trust national as opposed to judicial institutions. On the other hand, the lack of data on the number of intellectual property disputes resolved at the EACJ through arbitration, if any, points to legal, regulatory, policy and jurisprudential gaps which limit the capacity of the EACJ to be a reliable and effective regional dispute resolution mechanism for IP disputes. Therefore, this paper makes  a case for an expansive application of, the reconceptualization and redefinition of the scope, nature and extent of the arbitral jurisdiction of the EACJ to promote regional integration through the amicable resolution of IP disputes within the EAC bloc.

title: A Data-Driven Approach to Mapping Global Commodity-Specific Mining Land-Use
affiliations: Vienna University of Economics and Business

detail.title: A Data-Driven Approach to Mapping Global Commodity-Specific Mining Land-Use

declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the EU’s Horizon Europe project RAWCLIC (grant agreement no. 101183654) and European Research Council (ERC) project MINE-THE-GAP (grant agreement no. 101170578).

detail.abstract: Mining activities are a key driver of environmental and social change globally, yet geospatial data on mining operations remains fragmented and incomplete across data sources. This study proposes a scalable approach to integrate heterogeneous mining datasets and quantify global mine land associated with specific commodities. The new approach groups spatial data points into mine clusters through hierarchical clustering with locally optimised distance thresholds. The method enables the association between mine operations reported in inventory data and land-use polygons covering mine infrastructures derived from satellite data. Validation of the clusters against expert-labelled mines shows a high level of agreement on the associated primary commodities, with 95% of the clusters sharing at least one primary commodity. The resulting integrated dataset covers over 145,000 km² and offers the most comprehensive overview of global mine land use by associated primary commodity. It revealed that coal and gold dominate global mining land footprints and that mining has a disproportionately negative impact on tropical forest ecosystems, particularly due to gold mining. This methodology provides a reproducible approach to enhancing the integration of spatial data on mining activities, supporting more robust global assessments of mining impacts.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种可扩展的方法来整合异构采矿数据集，通过层次聚类和局部优化距离阈值将空间数据点分组为矿山集群，从而量化全球特定商品相关的矿山用地。
AI.research_question: 如何整合异构采矿数据集并量化全球特定商品相关的矿山用地？
AI.motivation: 采矿活动是全球环境和社会变化的关键驱动因素，但各数据源中采矿作业的地理空间数据仍然分散且不完整。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于空间数据整合理论和层次聚类方法，采用局部优化距离阈值进行矿山集群识别。
AI.method: 使用层次聚类和局部优化距离阈值将空间数据点分组为矿山集群，将库存数据中的采矿作业与卫星数据中的矿山基础设施用地多边形进行关联。
AI.findings: 验证显示95%的集群至少共享一个主要商品；整合数据集覆盖超过145,000 km²；煤炭和黄金主导全球采矿用地足迹；采矿对热带森林生态系统产生不成比例的负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了可重复的空间数据整合方法，为采矿活动影响评估提供了更稳健的全球评估框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了全球最全面的按主要商品分类的矿山用地概览，支持更准确的采矿影响评估和环境保护决策。

title: Macroeconomic Determinants of Housing Supply in Kenya
affiliations: University of Eldoret, University of Eldoret, University of Eldoret, University of Eldoret, University of Eldoret and University of Eldoret

detail.title: Macroeconomic Determinants of Housing Supply in Kenya
detail.abstract: Kenya is one of the developing countries trying to provide affordable and decent housing to its residents. Macroeconomic instability persists despite efforts, impeding housing supply from both government and real estate sectors. This study examines the macroeconomic factors influencing Kenya's housing supply from 1980 to 2024, using time-series data. The augmented Dickey-Fuller and Johansen co-integration tests are conducted, along with the Vector Error Correction Model, to assess long run relationships between the variables, which allows for the use of the error correction model. Moreover, the Granger causality test examines the causal links between the variables. In the long-run, house prices and economic growth positively impact house supply while inflation rate, interest rate and the government expenditure negatively impact the supply of housing. Short-run analysis reveals a negative coefficient for interest rates. Granger causality testing supports the one-way feedback hypothesis between interest rate and supply of houses. Study findings suggest that government should explore methods to develop financial products and instruments that make it easier for individuals and governments to finance housing projects and sustain reasonable profit margins.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨1980-2024年肯尼亚宏观经济因素对住房供给的影响，发现房价和经济增长正向影响供给，而通胀率、利率和政府支出负向影响供给。
AI.research_question: 肯尼亚的宏观经济因素如何影响住房供给？
AI.motivation: 肯尼亚作为发展中国家，在提供经济适用房方面面临挑战，宏观经济不稳定阻碍了政府和房地产部门的住房供给。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于宏观经济理论，研究房价、经济增长、通胀率、利率和政府支出对住房供给的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用1980-2024年的时间序列数据，进行ADF单位根检验、Johansen协整检验、向量误差修正模型(VECM)和格兰杰因果关系检验。
AI.findings: 长期来看：房价和经济增长正向影响住房供给；通胀率、利率和政府支出负向影响住房供给。短期来看：利率对住房供给有负向影响。格兰杰检验支持利率与住房供给之间存在单向因果关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家住房供给的宏观经济影响因素提供了实证证据，验证了相关理论在肯尼亚情境下的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议政府开发金融产品和工具，便于个人和政府融资住房项目并维持合理利润空间，以促进住房供给。

reference: Manthey, Dominic & Wang, Keren. (2025). Silent Protest and Cruel Imitation in Hong Kong’s “Umbrella Movement”. In Quiet Defiance: The Rhetoric of Silent Protest, edited by David W. Seitz. London and New York: Bloomsbury Publishing, DOI: 2025.10.5040/9781978748194.ch-016.
title: Silent Protest and Cruel Imitation in Hong Kong's "Umbrella Movement"
affiliations: Independent and Emory University

detail.title: Silent Protest and Cruel Imitation in Hong Kong's "Umbrella Movement"

publicationDetails.detailsText: Manthey, Dominic & Wang, Keren. (2025). Silent Protest and Cruel Imitation in Hong Kong’s “Umbrella Movement”. In Quiet Defiance: The Rhetoric of Silent Protest, edited by David W. Seitz. London and New York: Bloomsbury Publishing, DOI: 2025.10.5040/9781978748194.ch-016.

detail.abstract: This chapter analyzes Hong Kong's pro-democracy movement with special attention to how its initial popularity in 2014 set the stage for bad actors wishing to inflame the controversy with a silent method of protest. Specifically, we argue that as the "Umbrella Movement" rose in prominence and circulated across digital networks, new opportunities were given for acts of mimicry we label "cruel imitation." Through analyzing representative public texts alongside in situ observations, we trace this process from 2014 to 2019. While digital media granted grassroots activists an enormous range and flexibility to communicate, organize, and attract international attention, the widespread publicizing of the movement eventually diluted its central message. Beneath the iconic symbol of the yellow umbrella, the pro-democracy movement now included both reformists and revolutionaries despite little evidence of a shift from the originally moderate policy goal. Within this digitally circulated rhetoric-that was both popular and ambiguous-small groups of online activists marshaled a unique strategy of trolling by imitating the various sides of the debate. Just as technology gives older rhetorical styles new life, it also fosters new repertoires of collective action with direct consequences for democratic life. The more insidious of these occur in obscurity and silence, as we continue to see across digital platforms today.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了香港雨伞运动中数字媒体如何为"残酷模仿"式网络挑衅创造机会，虽然数字技术扩大了运动影响力但也模糊了核心信息，导致改革派与革命派混杂，最终被少数网络活动分子利用进行多方位模仿式网络挑衅。

AI.theoretical_framework: 数字媒体与社会运动理论、模仿理论、网络挑衅策略理论
AI.method: 代表性公共文本分析结合实地观察，时间跨度为2014-2019年
AI.findings: 数字媒体在扩大运动影响力的同时稀释了核心信息，导致运动内部派别混杂；少数网络活动分子利用这种模糊性发展出模仿各方的"残酷模仿"式网络挑衅策略
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"残酷模仿"概念，拓展了数字媒体对社会运动影响的理论框架，揭示了数字技术如何催生新型集体行动策略
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解当代数字平台上的隐蔽性网络挑衅行为提供分析框架，对民主运动组织者具有警示意义

title: The World War II US Rubber Famine
affiliations: Santa Clara University - Leavey School of Business - Economics Department

detail.title: The World War II US Rubber Famine
detail.abstract: By April 1942 Japan had cut off almost all US supplies of natural rubber, a key raw material for which the country had effectively no domestic sourcing. The resulting shortage aggravated downward pressure on manufacturing productivity and seriously jeopardized military capability. The risks that this would happen, widely foreseen, could have been mitigated by more or earlier stockpiling, subsidization of domestic plant-based sources of latex, or development of a synthetic rubber industry. At the time of Pearl Harbor, each route had been pursued in a limited fashion or not at all. This paper explores why, highlighting the outsized role played by businessman/politician Jesse Jones, as well as the multiple channels through which the rubber famine adversely affected the country’s wartime economy. This history starkly illuminates a policy dilemma still with us: how much ‘insurance’ should a country carry when it depends heavily on interruptible foreign sourcing of a strategic input?

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了1942年美国天然橡胶短缺的原因及其对战时经济的负面影响，重点分析了商人政治家杰西·琼斯的作用，并提出了关于战略物资依赖中断性外国供应的政策困境。
AI.research_question: 为什么美国在珍珠港事件前未能有效应对天然橡胶供应中断的风险？
AI.motivation: 1942年日本切断美国天然橡胶供应，严重威胁军事能力和制造业生产力，这一风险本可通过多种方式缓解但未被充分重视
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略物资供应链风险管理、政策制定与执行分析、战时经济管理
AI.method: 历史案例研究，分析档案资料和政策文件

AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了战略物资依赖中断性外国供应的政策困境，为现代供应链风险管理提供历史借鉴
AI.practical_contributions: 为当代国家战略物资储备和政策制定提供了历史教训，强调了提前规划和多元化供应的重要性

title: How Retrainable Are AI-Exposed Workers?
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of New York and New York University (NYU), Department of Economics, Students

detail.title: How Retrainable Are AI-Exposed Workers?

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of New York Staff Report No. 1165
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: https://doi.org/10.59576/sr.1165

detail.abstract: We document the extent to which workers in AI-exposed occupations can successfully retrain for AIintensive work. We assemble a new workforce development dataset spanning over 1.6 million job training participation spells from all U.S. Workforce Investment and Opportunity Act programs from 2012-2023 linked with occupational measures of AI exposure. Using earnings records observed before and after training, we compare high AI exposure trainees to a matched sample of similar workers who only received job search assistance. We find that AI-exposed workers have high earnings returns from training that are only 25 percent lower than the returns for low AI exposure workers. However, training participants who target AI-intensive occupations face a penalty for doing so, with 29 percent lower returns than AI-exposed workers pursuing more general training. We estimate that between 25 percent to 40 percent of occupations are "AI retrainable" as measured by its workers receiving higher pay for moving to more AI-intensive occupations-a large magnitude given the relatively low-income sample of displaced workers. Positive earnings returns in all groups are driven by the most recent years when labor markets were tightest, suggesting training programs may have stronger signal value when firms reach deeper into the skill market.

AI.tldr: 研究分析了AI暴露职业工人重新培训转行的效果，发现AI暴露工人通过培训获得的收益仅比低AI暴露工人低25%，但直接转向AI密集职业的工人反而遭遇25-40%的收益扣扣。
AI.research_question: AI暴露职业的工人能否通过培训成功转向AI密集工作？这种重新培训的效果如何？
AI.motivation: 人工智能对劳动力市场的影响日益增加，但AI暴露职业工人的再培训效果仍不明确，需要实证研究来指导职业培训政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论、职业转垂理论、技能培训效果评估理论
AI.method: 使用美国职业培训投资法案的160万余个培训参与记录，结合职业AI暴露度指标，通过培训前后收入数据进行对比分析，使用匹配样本法控制偏差。
AI.findings: 1) AI暴露工人培训收益仅比低AI暴露工人低25%；2) 直接转向AI密集职业的工人遭遇29%收益扣扣；3) 25-40%职业具有"AI再培训可能性"；4) 正面效果主要出现在劳动力市场紧张时期。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了AI时代职业转垂的实证识别方法，丰富了技能培训效果在技术变革背景下的理论内涵。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了AI时代职业培训的具体建议，指出了更有效的培训策略和职业转向路径。

title: Micro and Macro Perspectives on Production-Based Markups
affiliations: INSEAD, University of Pennsylvania, INSEAD and New York University (NYU)

detail.title: Micro and Macro Perspectives on Production-Based Markups
detail.abstract: We review the "production approach" to estimating markups---the ratio of price to marginal cost. Paired with increasingly rich microdata and advances in production function estimation, the method enables scalable analysis of markups across firms, industries, and time. We survey what economists need to know about the production approach, emphasizing both its promise and its fragility. Conceptually, empirically, and econometrically, the production-based markup is a residual---absorbing model misspecification, data limitations, and unobserved frictions. These challenges help explain why empirical results often diverge, including on whether markups have risen sharply in recent decades. We outline practical guidance for researchers and highlight directions for future work: improving transparency in reporting, validating production-based markups against demand-based and quasi-experimental estimates, and integrating firm-level heterogeneity into macroeconomic models. The production approach is not a finished product, but it remains a uniquely powerful tool for studying market power and its implications for productivity, welfare, and macroeconomic dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了基于生产函数估计的加成率（价格与边际成本之比）测算方法，分析了该方法的优势、局限性和应用挑战，并提出了改进方向和实践指导。
AI.research_question: 如何有效估计企业加成率？基于生产函数的方法在理论和实践中面临哪些挑战？
AI.motivation: 随着微观数据的丰富和生产函数估计方法的进步，基于生产函数的加成率估计方法成为研究市场力量的重要工具，但该方法存在概念、实证和计量方面的脆弱性，需要系统评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生产函数理论、成本函数理论、市场力量理论、剩余分析框架
AI.method: 文献综述法，系统梳理基于生产函数的加成率估计方法及其应用
AI.findings: 生产函数法估计的加成率是一个残差项，吸收了模型误设、数据限制和未观察到的摩擦；实证结果常常存在分歧；需要改进报告透明度、验证估计结果并整合企业异质性
AI.theory_contributions: 系统阐述了生产函数法估计加成率的理论基础、局限性和改进方向，为相关研究提供理论指导
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者提供了实用的操作指南，包括提高透明度、验证估计结果、整合异质性等具体建议

title: The TikTok Effect: A Behavioral Economics Literature Review on Short-Form Content and Gen- Z Decision-Making

detail.title: The TikTok Effect: A Behavioral Economics Literature Review on Short-Form Content and Gen- Z Decision-Making
detail.abstract: This paper explores how the pervasive nature of short-form content, exemplified by platforms like TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts, significantly impacts the attention, impulsivity, and economic decision-making of Generation Z. It delves into the underlying behavioral economics principles that these platforms leverage. The review examines concepts such as present bias, hyperbolic discounting, attention scarcity, variable reward loops, and overchoice, demonstrating how these cognitive tendencies are amplified by the unique design of short-form video platforms. Drawing on observations as a Gen Z individual and synthesizing academic literature, the paper illustrates how these mechanisms manifest in real-world behaviors, from compulsive scrolling to impulsive financial choices. It aims to offer insights into the ethical implications of platform design and propose avenues for fostering greater digital and financial literacy among youth.

AI.tldr: 短视频平台通过行为经济学原理（如现时偏见、注意力稀缺等）显著影响Z世代的注意力、冲动性和经济决策，需要关注平台设计的伦理影响并提升数字金融素养
AI.research_question: 短视频内容如何通过行为经济学原理影响Z世代的注意力、冲动性和经济决策？
AI.motivation: 探讨以TikTok、Instagram Reels和YouTube Shorts为代表的短视频平台对Z世代认知行为和经济决策的深远影响，以及相关的伦理考量
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学理论框架，包括现时偏见（present bias）、双曲线贴现（hyperbolic discounting）、注意力稀缺、可变奖励循环和选择过载（overchoice）
AI.method: 文献综述法，结合作为Z世代个体的观察体验，综合分析学术文献和实际行为表现
AI.findings: 短视频平台的设计放大了用户的认知倾向，导致强迫性滚动浏览和冲动性财务选择等行为模式
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对短视频平台如何利用行为经济学原理影响用户决策的理论理解，建立了平台设计与认知行为之间的理论联系
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台设计提供伦理启示，提出提升青少年数字素养和金融素养的具体途径，有助于制定更负责任的数字产品设计标准

title: Government-Funded Health Insurance: A Key Strategy to Mitigate Income Inequality
affiliations: Indian Institute of Management Jammu

detail.title: Government-Funded Health Insurance: A Key Strategy to Mitigate Income Inequality
detail.abstract: Income inequality is one of the most pressing socioeconomic challenges of the 21st century. As disparities in income and wealth widen, so do disparities in health outcomes (Marmot, 2005). In many countries, healthcare remains expensive, fragmented, and inaccessible to low-income groups, thereby reinforcing poverty and limiting upward mobility (WHO, 2010). This paper argues that expanding government-funded health insurance is a viable strategy to mitigate income inequality. Health insurance not only reduces out-of-pocket expenditures but also ensures equitable access to preventive and curative services, enabling poorer populations to remain healthier and more economically productive (Wagstaff et al., 2018). Drawing on international case studies and empirical evidence, this paper highlights the redistributive power of public health insurance schemes and the economic rationale for greater state investment in healthcare coverage. The analysis suggests that, far from being a fiscal burden, strategic public spending on health insurance is a high-return investment in social equity and long-term economic stability (Xu et al., 2007). The paper concludes with policy recommendations aimed at expanding coverage, improving quality, and integrating informal workers into the system-essential steps for governments committed to reducing inequality and achieving inclusive growth.

AI.tldr: 政府资助的医疗保险扩张是缓解收入不平等的有效策略，通过减少自付支出、确保公平获得医疗服务，帮助贫困人口保持健康和经济生产力，实现社会公平和长期经济稳定。
AI.research_question: 政府资助的医疗保险如何作为缓解收入不平等的可行策略？
AI.motivation: 收入不平等是21世纪最紧迫的社会经济挑战之一，收入差距扩大导致健康结果差距扩大，医疗保健对低收入群体昂贵且难以获得，加剧贫困并限制向上流动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于健康不平等理论（Marmot, 2005）和医疗保健可及性理论（WHO, 2010），以及公共医疗保险的再分配效应理论（Wagstaff et al., 2018）。
AI.method: 采用国际案例研究和实证证据分析，考察公共医疗保险计划的再分配能力和经济合理性。
AI.findings: 公共医疗保险不仅减少自付支出，确保公平获得预防和治疗服务，还能使贫困人口保持更健康和经济生产力，是促进社会公平和长期经济稳定的高回报投资。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了公共医疗保险作为收入再分配工具的理论认识，证明了其在减少健康不平等和促进社会公平方面的理论价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了扩大覆盖范围、提高质量和将非正规工人纳入系统的政策建议，为政府减少不平等和实现包容性增长提供实践指导。

detail.abstract: We take an off-the-shelf model of the day-ahead electricity market, adapted from Reguant (2019), and use it to study how different emergency policy interventions proposed in response to the 2021–2022 European energy crisis would feed into short-run wholesale electricity price and consumption dynamics. Calibrating the model to Italian data, our analysis predicts that an EU-wide cap on natural gas prices significantly lowers electricity prices, while consumed quantities increase only marginally. A mandated reduction in electricity demand during peak hours leads to modest price declines, while a national cap on gas prices for electricity generation triggers a sharper increase in consumption. These findings suggest that emergency interventions can mitigate the short-term impact of price shocks, though they may also lead to increases in energy consumption and market distortions.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文使用现有电力市场模型分析了欧洲能源危机期间的紧急政策干预效果，发现天然气价格上限能大幅降低电价，而需求减少措施的效果较小，国家级气价上限则会导致消费明显增加。
AI.research_question: 不同紧急政策干预如何影响短期批发电价和消费动态？
AI.motivation: 困难时期的紧急能源政策需要实证基础，以确保其能够有效缓解价格冲击而不造成市场扬矩
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Reguant(2019)的现货电力市场模型，重点考虑供需关系和价格形成机制
AI.method: 采用现成模型进行数值模拟，以意大利数据进行参数检定，模拟不同政策干预场景
AI.findings: 欧盟范围天然气价格上限导致电价显著下降，消费量仅微增；高峰需求减少仅造成轻微价格下降；国家级气价上限引发消费明显增加
AI.theory_contributions: 为能源市场紧急干预政策提供理论分析框架，完善了市场干预效果预测模型
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供具体的干预方案效果预测，帮助避免不良市场扬矩，提高危机应对政策的有效性

detail.abstract: The Astro-Quantum Navigation Array (AQNA) is a compact, affordable navigation system that integrates star trackers, quantum gyroscopes, and AI to deliver 1-meter accuracy without GPS. Priced under $500, AQNA operates in GPS-denied environments like urban canyons, Arctic regions, and space. Simulations across 10 environments show a 90% error reduction compared to GPS and inertial systems. AQNA supports drones, spacecraft, and disaster response, potentially saving $10 billion annually. Its universal design democratizes precision navigation, advancing aerospace safety and exploration.

detail.abstract: At first glance, questioning the existence of ecosystems in competition law may seem merely provocative. After all, the term is pervasive in the antitrust debate, where competition in today's digital world is routinely described as a race between and within ecosystems. Accordingly, new theories of harm and substantial adjustments to traditional antitrust analysis are frequently invoked. However, upon closer examination, doubts arise about the actual novelty of the concept. While the term 'ecosystem' evocatively captures the seemingly irrepressible expansion of digital conglomerates, the paper investigates whether it is also grounded in a genuinely distinctive analytical framework and legal theory.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑"生态系统"概念在竞争法中的真正新颖性，认为虽然该术语在数字反垄断讨论中广泛使用，但可能缺乏独特的分析框架和法律理论基础。
AI.research_question: "生态系统"概念是否建立在真正独特的分析框架和法律理论基础之上？
AI.motivation: 尽管"生态系统"术语在数字竞争法中普遍使用并引发了新的损害理论和传统反垄断分析的调整，但需要质疑其概念的新颖性和理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争法理论、数字市场分析框架、生态系统概念的法律理论基础
AI.method: 概念分析和理论检验，通过检视现有文献和案例来评估"生态系统"概念的理论基础
AI.findings: "生态系统"术语虽然形象地描述了数字企业的扩张，但可能缺乏真正独特的分析框架和法律理论支撑
AI.theory_contributions: 对竞争法中流行但理论基础薄弱的"生态系统"概念进行批判性分析，促进更严谨的理论发展
AI.practical_contributions: 为竞争执法机构和政策制定者提供对"生态系统"概念更清醒的认识，避免基于不成熟理论的政策决策

title: Overshooting of (Useful) Cultural Practices
affiliations: London Business School, Judge Business School and Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile

detail.title: Overshooting of (Useful) Cultural Practices
detail.abstract: Prior research has traditionally examined how useful practices spread in organizations and how they develop over time. However, it has been observed that practices can "overshoot," either because there is overdiffusion-some agents adopt to the detriment of organizational performance-or because there is oversophistication-the practice is overly developed, becoming too elaborate and reducing organizational performance. Independent models of over-diffusion and over-sophistication have been proposed; this paper integrates both aspects in a simple and unified model of overshooting. We offer a cultural evolution model that studies how interaction dynamics among employees are able to diffuse and stabilize an equilibrium of under-performing cultural practices, and at the same time, over-develop the practice so its sophistication goes beyond productive levels. People adopt practices from others based on information about the practice's true productive value (including its decreasing marginal return as it diffuses), but also influenced by social dynamics with other employees, such as social pressure and status. Our model clarifies under which circumstances over-diffusion and over-sophistication can happen, and how these two elements of overshooting relate to one another. We map our model in detail to two cases: process management practices (e.g., six sigma) and Uber's aggressive culture.

AI.tldr: 本文通过文化进化模型研究组织中实践的"超调"现象，整合了过度扩散和过度精细化两个维度，探讨了社会动力如何导致低效能文化实践的稳定化。
AI.research_question: 组织中实践如何通过社会动力机制导致"超调"（过度扩散和过度精细化），以及这两者之间的关系是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统研究主要关注有用实践的扩散和发展，但实践可能出现"超调"现象，既有的模型分别研究过度扩散和过度精细化，需要整合两者提供统一视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文化进化理论，社会动力机制（社会压力、地位），越界效应理论（逐步减少的边际收益）
AI.method: 建立简单统一的文化进化模型，研究员工之间互动动力学如何扩散并稳定化低效能文化实践，同时过度发展实践精细度
AI.findings: 模型明确了过度扩散和过度精细化发生的条件，以及这两者之间的关系，并将模型映射到流程管理实践（如六西格玛）和Uber兵凛文化两个案例
AI.theory_contributions: 提出统一的"超调"模型，整合了过度扩散和过度精细化两个之前独立研究的概念，为理解组织中实践的负面效应提供新视角
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助组织识别和预防实践"超调"风险，通过理解社会动力对实践扩散和发展的影响，为管理实践推广提供指导

title: Code Before Clause: Building Canada's Digital Defences Before Negotiating Trade
affiliations: New York Law School

detail.title: Code Before Clause: Building Canada's Digital Defences Before Negotiating Trade

declarations.funderStatement: The article was originally published in the Balsillie Papers on 23 August 2025.

detail.abstract: This paper argues that Canada must pause exploratory digital trade negotiations with the European Union until it legislates a domestic digital sovereignty framework. Digital trade agreements are no longer mere commercial arrangements; they function as constitutional documents that determine who governs the infrastructures of the 21st century—data, algorithms, and cloud. By proceeding prematurely, Canada risks embedding structural dependence into binding international law. The Global Affairs Canada’s consultation process situates Canada’s vulnerability within the asymmetry of U.S. and EU digital governance models and introduces “code before clause” as a doctrine requiring sovereign legislation to precede trade commitments. Immediate recommendations include legislating a digital sovereignty framework, strengthening institutional capacity, and adopting a doctrine of technological non-alignment to safeguard Canada’s autonomy in the algorithmic age.

detail.abstract: Similar to the previous chapter on Kelo v. City of New London, this chapter revolves around a case study of state-mandated ritual sacrifice for economic redevelopment. The first half of the chapter provides relevant facts and legal context on the Vedanta controversya 2013 land dispute between Vedanta Resources, a British multinational mining company, and a small indigenous tribe in India. The second half of the chapter analyzes the rhetoric of ritual and theological elements underpinning the Vedanta controversy. The ritual analysis in this chapter focuses on the role of legal pístis in the ritualization of state-mandated sacrifice, as well as the strategic deployment of rituals as countermeasures, to resist the state authority's monopoly for the legitimate use of ritual public sacrifice.

title: Volatility-Weighted Concentration and Effective Fragility in U.S. Equity Markets

detail.title: Volatility-Weighted Concentration and Effective Fragility in U.S. Equity Markets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships that could be perceived to have influenced the research reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses only synthetic data calibrated to historical market moments. No human participants or proprietary datasets were involved, and therefore ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: The recent performance of the U.S stock market has become heavily dependent on a handful of technology mega-caps. This paper investigates whether market concentration in these tech giants has reached problematic levels. We employ empirical measures of concentration such as the Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI), create "ex-tech" versions of major indices, run regression and beta analyses, and examine exchangetraded fund (ETF) exposure data. We find that concentration levels are at multi-decade highs: for example, the top five companies now constitute over one-fifth of the S&P 500's capitalization, and index HHI readings have reached unprecedented levels. Index returns in recent years have been disproportionately driven by this "Magnificent 7" cohort, as simulations and historical data show that removing these firms dramatically reduces index gains. Our hypothetical stress tests of a tech-sector shock indicate outsized impacts on broad indices, underscoring potential systemic fragility. These findings suggest that cap-weighted passive investment strategies may be reinforcing the dominance of mega-cap tech, raising portfolio concentration risk. We discuss implications for investors, including diversification considerations and the merits of equal-weight or ex-tech strategies, as well as broader policy implications regarding market stability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现美国股市过度集中于少数科技巨头，市场集中度达数十年新高，科技股对指数回报贡献过大，存在系统性风险隐患，建议投资者考虑分散化策略。
AI.research_question: 美国股市对科技巨头的市场集中度是否已达到问题水平？
AI.motivation: 近期美国股市表现过度依赖少数科技巨头，需要评估这种集中度是否构成系统性风险
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场集中度理论、投资组合理论、系统性风险理论
AI.method: 使用赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数(HHI)等集中度指标、创建"排除科技股"指数版本、回归和贝塔分析、ETF敞口数据分析、压力测试模拟
AI.findings: 市场集中度达数十年新高：前五大公司占标普500市值超20%；指数HHI读数达前所未有水平；"壮丽七巨头"对近年指数回报贡献过大；科技板块冲击压力测试显示对宽基指数影响巨大
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对市场集中度与系统性风险关系的理解，为投资组合理论和风险管理理论提供新证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供分散化策略建议（等权重或排除科技股策略），警示被动投资策略可能加剧集中风险，为监管机构提供市场稳定性政策建议

title: Trade, Tariffs and Trade Wars: Income and Inequality Effects
affiliations: Korea University Business School, Independent, University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) - Anderson School of Management and Korea University Business School

detail.title: Trade, Tariffs and Trade Wars: Income and Inequality Effects
detail.abstract: There are growing concerns about the benefits of trade and globalization in terms of their impact on income distribution and inequality. We present a single-period model of trade with tariffs encompassing multiple regions and products, in which some goods may be traded, whereas others may not. Individuals (entities) make production and consumption decisions and each region can set tariffs on imported products. Each region distributes the collected tariffs to individuals within the region either equally or to minimize income inequality. The prices are determined using the Walrasian equilibrium mechanism. We demonstrate the existence of various solution concepts used in multiple decision stages and conduct comparative static analyses. We perform a numerical study using stylized models with two regions, two products, and specific (quadratic form) choices for production functions and consumption utilities. We examine the consequences of trade on the average income and income distribution for such examples. We then consider the effect of tariffs on income and inequality, and examine the (Nash) equilibrium choices for tariff levels in the two regions. We find that the resulting equilibrium involves tariffs, contrary to free trade (i.e., no tariffs), whereby the total revenue across both regions is maximized. Pareto-optimal allocations yielding higher revenue than the equilibrium outcome can be achieved under asymmetric tariff structures, wherein tariffs are imposed by one region while the other remains tariff-free.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多区域多产品贸易关税模型，分析了贸易和全球化对收入分配和不平等的影响。研究发现，纳什均衡下会出现关税而非自由贸易，且非对称关税结构能实现帕累托最优分配。
AI.research_question: 贸易和全球化对收入分配和不平等的影响是什么？关税政策如何影响区域间的收入水平和收入不平等？
AI.motivation: 随着贸易和全球化的发展，人们越来越关注其对收入分配和不平等的影响，需要建立理论模型来分析关税政策的经济效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多区域多产品贸易模型，包含关税机制和瓦尔拉斯均衡定价，采用纳什均衡和帕累托最优等解概念。
AI.method: 构建单期贸易关税模型，进行理论分析和比较静态分析，并通过数值模拟（两区域两产品模型）验证理论结果。
AI.findings: 纳什均衡下会出现关税而非自由贸易；非对称关税结构能实现帕累托最优，使总收入高于均衡结果；关税政策对收入水平和收入分配有显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了包含关税再分配机制的多区域贸易理论框架，扩展了贸易理论对收入分配问题的分析能力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关税政策设计的理论依据，表明非对称关税结构可能在提高总收入的同时改善收入分配。

title: Selection, Structural Transformation, and the Cost Disease of Services
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen - School of Management and Economics

detail.title: Selection, Structural Transformation, and the Cost Disease of Services

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No human subject was involved in this research.
declarations.funderStatement: The author acknowledges financial support from the Shenzhen Peacock Project 2024TC0060.

detail.abstract: Labor productivity growth in the service sector may be mismeasured if workers with heterogeneous skills self-select into sectors. I document with U.S. data that workers reallocated from manufacturing earn more than incumbent workers in professional services but less than incumbent workers in education, health, and public services. A generalized quantitative Roy model predicts a selection effect on labor productivity growth in professional services that is 10 percentage points higher than what a conventional selection model predicts. Overall, the selection effect contributes little to the cost disease of services, which contrasts sharply with the hypothesis in the literature.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过定量Roy模型分析强调了工人异质性技能选择对服务业劳务生产率增长测量的影响，发现选择效应对服务业成本疾病的贡献微小，与现有文献偏向的假设形成明显对比。
AI.research_question: 工人异质性技能选择如何影响服务业劳务生产率增长的测量？选择效应在服务业成本疾病中扮演什么样的角色？
AI.motivation: 服务业劳务生产率增长可能因为工人异质性技能的自我选择而被错误测量，现有文献偏向于认为选择效应是服务业成本疾病的重要因素，需要更精确的定量分析来验证这一偏向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于定量Roy模型（Roy model）的理论框架，特别是广义定量Roy模型，用于分析工人在不同部门间的技能选择和收入差异。
AI.method: 使用美国数据，记录了从制造业重分配到服务业的工人与现有工人的收入差异，并通过广义定量Roy模型进行预测分析。
AI.findings: 发现从制造业重分配的工人在专业服务业比现有工人赢得更多，但在教育、健康和公共服务业则赢得更少。广义Roy模型预测的选择效应比传统模型高出10个百分点。整体而言，选择效应对服务业成本疾病的贡献微小。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并验证了广义定量Roy模型在服务业劳务生产率测量中的优势，进一步丰富了劳务经济学中关于工人选择效应的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 结果对服务业劳务生产率测量和政策制定具有重要意义，指出应重新考虑服务业成本疾病的根源，而不是简单归因于工人选择效应。

detail.title: The Effects of Tenure-Track Systems on Selection and Productivity in Economics

publicationDetails.detailsText: IZA Discussion Paper No. 18083

detail.abstract: This paper examines how publication-based tenure-track systems affect the careers of Ph.D. graduates in Economics. We leverage a 2010 reform in Italy that replaced open-ended assistant professor (AP) positions with fixed-term contracts and introduced publication minimum requirements for career advancement. Using survey and administrative data, along with a Difference-in-Differences Event-Study approach comparing Economics to less academicallyoriented fields, we find that the reform significantly reduced the likelihood of Economics Ph.D. graduates entering academia in Italy, while increasing transitions to academic careers abroad or to public and private sector jobs. Talented graduates were disproportionately affected, revealing negative selection into Italian academia following the removal of permanent AP positions. Despite these trends, tenure-track hires tend to publish more in high-ranking journals, suggesting that the reforms incentive effects may partly mitigate its negative selection effects.

AI.tldr: 意大利2010年学术改革将终身制助理教授职位改为固定期限合同并引入发表要求，导致经济学博士毕业生进入意大利学术界的可能性显著降低，但提高了他们在国外学术界或公私部门就业的比例。改革对高才华毕业生影响更大，虽然存在负面选择效应，但终身制聘用者的高水平期刊发表量增加。
AI.research_question: 基于发表的终身制聘任制度如何影响经济学博士毕业生的职业发展？
AI.motivation: 研究意大利2010年学术体系改革的影响，该改革用固定期限合同取代终身制助理教授职位并引入发表最低要求，旨在理解这种改革对博士毕业生学术职业选择的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于职业选择理论、激励机制理论和人才流动理论，分析学术聘任制度改革对博士毕业生职业路径的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用调查和行政数据，采用双重差分事件研究法，比较经济学领域与学术导向较弱领域的差异。
AI.findings: 改革显著降低了经济学博士毕业生进入意大利学术界的可能性，增加了他们到国外学术界或公私部门就业的转换率；高才华毕业生受到不成比例的影响；尽管存在负面选择，但终身制聘用者在高水平期刊上的发表量增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 为学术聘任制度改革对博士毕业生职业选择的影响提供了实证证据，揭示了激励机制与选择效应之间的复杂关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于学术聘任制度改革实际效果的见解，有助于设计更有效的学术职业发展体系。

title: The Ragsdale Framework for Autonomous Organizations: A Structured Path from AI Adoption to Autonomization
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Ragsdale Framework for Autonomous Organizations: A Structured Path from AI Adoption to Autonomization

declarations.funderStatement: This research was entirely self-funded and conducted by the author in his independent capacity. It was not funded, sponsored, or commissioned by Kaamfu Inc. or any other organization.

detail.abstract:
Artificial intelligence is reshaping organizational design, yet most adoptions remain fragmented—pilots, siloed tools, and experiments that fail to scale. Without structure, AI often amplifies dysfunction, accelerating confusion rather than progress. This paper introduces the Ragsdale Framework for Autonomous Organizations (RFAO), a roadmap for transitioning from human-dependent operations toward intelligent, self-managing enterprises.

The RFAO defines organizations not simply as collections of people and processes, but as groups of people making decisions in pursuit of shared goals. What distinguishes effective organizations is the quality and speed of their decision flow—the connective tissue linking opportunities, goals, actions, and outcomes. To capture this, the framework introduces the Decision Acceleration Circuit, a model for how decisions move through organizations and generate leverage.

The model advances through four phases of maturity: Pre-Alignment (fragmented data, unreliable AI pilots), Alignment (structured workflows and high-quality data), Acceleration (AI-enforced standards and predictive insights), and Autonomization (AI dynamically coordinating execution under human direction).

The framework is grounded in the author’s own software ventures—Prospus (2010–present) and Kaamfu (2020–present)—which served as laboratories for experimentation and live implementation. This dual foundation—conceptual model plus empirical validation—positions the RFAO as both a theoretical contribution to organizational science and a practical guide for enterprises navigating the transition to autonomy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Ragsdale自主组织框架（RFAO），为组织从依赖人工操作向智能自管理企业转型提供路线图，通过决策加速回路模型和四个成熟度阶段帮助企业实现AI规模化应用。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个系统性的框架来帮助组织实现从人工依赖型运营向智能自主型企业的成功转型？
AI.motivation: 当前大多数AI应用呈现碎片化状态——试点项目、孤立工具和难以规模化的实验，缺乏结构化方法导致AI往往放大组织功能障碍而非推动进步
AI.theoretical_framework: Ragsdale自主组织框架（RFAO），将组织定义为追求共同目标的人群决策集合，核心是决策加速回路模型
AI.method: 基于作者自身软件企业Prospus（2010年至今）和Kaamfu（2020年至今）的实验和实际实施，采用概念模型加实证验证的双重基础
AI.findings: 提出了四个成熟度阶段：预对齐（碎片化数据、不可靠AI试点）、对齐（结构化工作流和高质量数据）、加速（AI强制执行标准和预测性洞察）、自主化（AI在人类指导下动态协调执行）
AI.theory_contributions: 为组织科学提供了理论贡献，提出了新的组织定义和决策流动模型
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业向自主化转型提供了实用指南，具有实际可操作性的路线图

title: The Impact of Various Factors on the Effectiveness of Internal Audit in the Public Sector: The Case of Bosnia and Herzegovina

detail.title: The Impact of Various Factors on the Effectiveness of Internal Audit in the Public Sector: The Case of Bosnia and Herzegovina

declarations.ethicsApproval: The study was conducted in accordance with ethical standards; informed consent was obtained from all participants.

detail.abstract: The paper focuses on analyzing key factors influencing the effectiveness of internal audit in the public sector of Bosnia and Herzegovina (BiH). Through multiple regression analysis (Ordinary Least Squares-OLS), the impact of five independent variables (competence of internal auditors, size of internal audit department, relationship between internal and external auditors, management support for internal audit, and independence of internal auditors), two control variables (organization's sector and total number of employees in the organization), on the dependent variable (effectiveness of internal audit) was measured.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多元回归分析研究了波黑公共部门内部审计有效性的关键影响因素，包括审计师能力、部门规模、内外审关系、管理层支持和审计独立性五个自变量对审计有效性的影响
AI.research_question: 波黑公共部门内部审计有效性的关键影响因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 探究公共部门内部审计有效性的决定因素，为提升波黑公共部门的治理水平和审计质量提供实证依据
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于内部审计有效性理论框架，重点关注审计师专业能力、组织支持、审计独立性等核心理论要素
AI.method: 多元回归分析（普通最小二乘法-OLS），包含5个自变量和2个控制变量对因变量（内部审计有效性）的影响测量
AI.findings: 研究发现五个独立变量（审计师能力、部门规模、内外审关系、管理层支持、审计独立性）对内部审计有效性有显著影响
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了公共部门内部审计有效性的理论框架，为发展中国家公共部门审计研究提供了实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为波黑公共部门提升内部审计有效性提供了具体改进方向，有助于加强公共部门的治理和问责机制

title: A Leadership Role Analysis regarding the Performance, Motivation and Stress Levels of Software Professionals in Remote Work
affiliations: Universidad de los Andes, Universidad de los Andes, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Universidad Autónoma de Tamaulipas, Universidad de Sonora, University of Castilla-La Mancha and Universidad Nacional del Comahue

detail.title: A Leadership Role Analysis regarding the Performance, Motivation and Stress Levels of Software Professionals in Remote Work

publicationDetails.detailsText: JSSOFTWARE-D-25-01216

detail.abstract: The transition to remote work has fundamentally transformed workplace dynamics in the software development industry, and it would consequently be interesting to analyse how the different software–team members perceive this change from working in the office every, or almost every, day, to the new mainly remote or remote-first work style. Various studies concerning how this trend has affected different aspects such as productivity currently exist. Most of these studies have been performed in Europe, principally in Scandinavian countries. Our work focuses on analysing how remote work has affected the different roles in software teams and we have, therefore, conducted a survey in Argentina, Colombia, Spain and Mexico in which 232 software professionals from 87 different organisations participated. Statistical methods including t-tests and effect size calculations were used with the aim of investigating differences in the participants’ perceptions of performance, motivation and stress according to their roles with regard to demographic variables such as country, gender and remote-work adoption level.  The empirical findings provide the first comprehensive quantitative evidence of role-based remote work differences in the Latin-American context, suggesting that organisations should implement differentiated remote-work policies tailored to specific leadership roles and demographic groups.

AI.tldr: 本文通过在拉丁美国和西班牙进行的调查研究，揭示了软件开发团队中不同角色在远程工作下对性能、动机和压力感知的差异，为企业制定分异化远程工作政策提供了量化依据。
AI.research_question: 远程工作如何影响软件开发团队中不同角色的性能、动机和压力感知？
AI.motivation: 远程工作已经根本改变了软件开发行业的工作模式，但现有研究主要集中在欧洲，特别是斯坎纳维亚国家，缺乏在拉丁美洲上下文中的角色基础差异分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于远程工作对团队动态影响的现有理论，重点考虑了角色特定的感知差异和人口统计学变量的交互作用。
AI.method: 在阿根廷、哥伦比亚、西班牙和墨西哥进行调查研究，收集232名来自87个不同组织的软件专业人员数据，使用t检验和效应量计算等统计方法分析角色间的感知差异。
AI.findings: 获得了拉丁美洲上下文中首个综合性的量化证据，显示了不同领导角色和人口统计学组织在远程工作中存在显著的感知差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了拉丁美洲远程工作研究的空白，提供了角色基础的远程工作感知差异的理论见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业制定分异化的远程工作政策提供了具体建议，特别是针对特定领导角色和人口统计学组织的个性化安排。

title: Accounting-Employee Flows and Financial Reporting Quality
affiliations: University at Buffalo (SUNY) - School of Management, University at Buffalo (SUNY) - School of Management and State University of New York (SUNY) - University at Buffalo

detail.title: Accounting-Employee Flows and Financial Reporting Quality
detail.abstract: Although many firms are concerned about the difficulty in hiring, training, and retaining qualified accounting staff, the human capital of rank-and-file employees is difficult to measure, and its link to a firm's financial reporting quality (FRQ) thus remains largely an open question. We use novel time-series data to examine how different aspects of accounting-employee flows predict FRQ revelations. We find that accounting-employee flows, as measured by its three primary components-(1) churning, (2) net attrition, and (3) net hiring of accounting employees-are positively associated with firms disclosing internal control weaknesses, filing late annual reports, and issuing less timely earnings announcements. We also find that accounting-employee flows are associated with higher audit fees and inaccurate management forecasts. Our study provides new evidence that employee instability within the financial reporting department can be a salient leading indicator of FRQ.

AI.tldr: 研究发现会计人员流动（包括流失、净减员和净招聘）与财务报告质量下降显著相关，表现为内部控制缺陷披露增加、年报延迟提交、盈余公告不及时、审计费用上升和管理预测不准确。
AI.research_question: 会计人员流动如何影响企业的财务报告质量？
AI.motivation: 企业在招聘、培训和留住合格会计人员方面面临困难，但人力资本难以衡量，其与财务报告质量的关系尚未明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人力资本理论和财务报告质量理论，探讨员工稳定性对财务报告流程的影响。
AI.method: 使用新颖的时间序列数据，分析会计人员流动的三个主要组成部分（流失、净减员、净招聘）与财务报告质量指标的关系。
AI.findings: 会计人员流动与内部控制缺陷披露、年报延迟提交、盈余公告不及时、审计费用上升和管理预测不准确呈正相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了会计人力资本不稳定影响财务报告质量的新证据，拓展了人力资本与财务报告质量关系的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业识别财务报告风险提供了新的预警指标，帮助管理者关注会计部门人员稳定性对财务报告质量的重要影响。

title: Do Households Adapt? Repeated Hurricane Exposure and the Purchasing of Bottled Water
affiliations: Pennsylvania State University, Pennsylvania State University, Agricultural Economics, Sociology, and Education and College of Agricultural Sciences, Department of Agricultural Economics and Rural Sociology

detail.title: Do Households Adapt? Repeated Hurricane Exposure and the Purchasing of Bottled Water

publicationDetails.detailsText: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper Series

detail.abstract: Understanding how households adapt to hurricanes is increasingly important as these events become more frequent and severe. This paper examines how past hurricane exposure influences current household preparedness, focusing specifically on the stockpiling of bottled water. Leveraging scanner data on bottled water purchases for households in the Southeastern United States, we employ a difference-indifferences event study framework to analyze how repeated hurricane experiences affect consumer behavior. Our results indicate that households exposed to hurricane warnings do not increase their preparedness in the subsequent hurricane season, and those experiencing a landfall event underprepare. These results suggest limited learning from past events.

AI.tldr: 通过分析美国东南部家庭的瓶装水购买数据，研究发现经历风暴的家庭在后续风暴季节并没有增加预防准备，反而减少准备，表明家庭从过去风暴经验中学习效果有限。
AI.research_question: 过去的风暴经历如何影响当前家庭的预防准备行为？特别是瓶装水储备行为。
AI.motivation: 由于风暴事件趋于频繁和严重，了解家庭如何适应风暴变得越来越重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 学习理论和风险认知理论，探讨个体如何从过去经验中学习并调整其预防行为。
AI.method: 采用双重差分式事件研究框架，利用美国东南部家庭的瓶装水购买扫描仪数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 经历风暴警告的家庭在后续风暴季节没有增加预防准备，而经历风暴登陆的家庭准备不足，表明学习效果有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了关于家庭如何对风险事件做出反应的新见解，质疑了传统学习理论在极端事件情况下的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 对于风险管理政策和公共教育有重要意义，帮助政府和相关部门更有效地提高家庭的预防能力。

title: Traditional Bias Training Doesn’t Work— Bias Interrupters Do
affiliations: UC Law, San Francisco, affiliation not provided to SSRN, UC Law, San Francisco, UC Law, San Francisco and UC Law, San Francisco

detail.title: Traditional Bias Training Doesn’t Work— Bias Interrupters Do
detail.abstract: Unexamined bias-that is, systems or individuals who unfairly favor some groups over others-hurts employees and organizations. Bias has many negative effects: companies don't tap the full talent pool when hiring; employees can't do their best work; unwanted attrition occurs when people leave due to lack of opportunities. However, it is possible to prevent these negative effects of bias in the workplace. Companies can make steady year-on-year progress toward their diversity, equity & inclusion (DEI) goals by using Bias Interrupters and following the lessons to ensure success and avoid common derailers.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了职场偏见对员工和组织的负面影响，提出了使用"偏见中断器"和遵循特定经验教训来帮助公司实现DEI目标的解决方案。
AI.research_question: 如何有效防止职场偏见对员工和组织的负面影响，并实现持续性的多元化、公平性和包容性目标？
AI.motivation: 未被审视的偏见会损害员工和组织，导致人才流失、员工无法发挥最佳水平，以及公司无法充分利用人才库等问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多元化、公平性和包容性(DEI)理论框架，结合组织行为学和人力资源管理理论。
AI.method: 提出使用"偏见中断器"(Bias Interrupters)的方法，并总结确保成功和避免常见失败因素的经验教训。
AI.findings: 通过实施偏见中断器和遵循特定策略，公司可以在DEI目标方面取得逐年稳步进展。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了DEI理论在实践应用方面的研究，提出了具体的干预工具和方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了可操作的工具和策略来识别和中断职场偏见，帮助实现DEI目标，减少人才流失，提升组织效能。

title: Is More Always Better? External Consultants and Firm Innovation in Emerging Markets
affiliations: Copenhagen Business School - Department of Economics

detail.title: Is More Always Better? External Consultants and Firm Innovation in Emerging Markets
detail.abstract: I analyse the relationship between hiring external consultants and firm innovation in emerging markets. Firms in these economic environments face specific problems that hinder organizational activities such as innovation. Hiring external consultants is considered a particularly important strategy to overcome these corporate inefficiencies as it provides firms with access to skills and knowledge. The results for a sample of firms from 32 countries imply that firms that hire external consultants are more likely to conduct product and process innovation. Moreover, the use of advisory services is positively associated with the likelihood of undertaking more ambitious innovation projects in terms of disruptiveness and the number of innovation types. Determining the impact of the consulting intensity, I show that the relation between the number of interactions with external consultants and innovation is inversely U-shaped. This implies that more consulting is not always better.

AI.tldr: 本文研究新兴市场中企业雇佣外部顾问与创新之间的关系，发现雇佣顾问能促进产品和流程创新，但咨询强度与创新呈倒U型关系，说明并非咨询越多越好。
AI.research_question: 新兴市场中企业雇佣外部顾问如何影响企业创新？
AI.motivation: 新兴市场企业面临特定问题阻碍创新活动，雇佣外部顾问被认为是克服这些组织低效的重要策略，可帮助企业获取技能和知识。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于组织学习和知识获取理论，外部顾问为企业提供专业知识和技能，帮助克服创新障碍。
AI.method: 对来自32个国家的企业样本进行实证分析，研究雇佣外部顾问与创新活动的关系。
AI.findings: 1) 雇佣外部顾问的企业更可能进行产品和流程创新；2) 咨询服务使用与更具颠覆性和更多创新类型的项目正相关；3) 咨询强度与创新呈倒U型关系，适度咨询效果最佳。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对新兴市场企业创新障碍和外部知识获取机制的理解，提出了咨询强度与创新的非线性关系理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴市场企业提供了雇佣外部顾问的策略指导，指出适度咨询而非过度咨询的创新效益最大化原则。

publicationDetails.detailsText: Hong Kong Institute for Monetary and Financial Research (HKIMR) Research Paper No. 10/2025
publicationDetails.journalName: Hong Kong Institute for Monetary & Financial Research (HKIMR) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This research paper is written by Yanke Dai (Shanghai University of International Business and Economics), Huasheng Gao (Fudan University), Na Li (Chinese University of Hong Kong), and Yujia Si (Fudan University).

This study examines the impact of patent collateralisation on entrepreneurship by exploiting policy changes in China that allow firms to use patents as collateral for financing. Our findings indicate that enhanced patent collateralisation significantly stimulates entrepreneurial startup activity, particularly within high-tech sectors. We identify three key channels through which this occurs: (1) facilitating access to debt and equity financing in the primary capital market; (2) enhancing liquidity in the secondary market for intellectual property; and (3) incentivising talented individuals to become entrepreneurs. Our findings highlight the economic benefits of patent collateralisation and its potential to foster the growth of high-tech startups.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用中国允许专利作为融资抵押品的政策变化，考察专利抵押对创业的影响。研究发现增强专利抵押显著刺激了创业活动，特别是在高科技领域，主要通过三个渠道实现：促进一级市场债务和股权融资、增强知识产权二级市场流动性、激励人才成为创业者。

AI.motivation: 研究专利作为抵押品的政策变化如何影响创业活动，特别是在高科技领域的发展。

AI.method: 利用中国允许专利抵押的政策变化作为准自然实验，采用实证分析方法。
AI.findings: 增强专利抵押显著刺激了创业活动，特别是在高科技领域，通过三个关键渠道发挥作用。

title: Comparative Scientometric Mapping of Risk Management Research Using Google Scholar and Scopus Data (2015–2024)
affiliations: Gopal Narayan Singh University

detail.title: Comparative Scientometric Mapping of Risk Management Research Using Google Scholar and Scopus Data (2015–2024)
detail.abstract: This study use scientometric techniques to map and analyse global-level research on risk management strategies between 2015 and 2024 it aims to identify thematic structures, influential contributors, and research gaps between existing literatures. Using bibliographic records majorly from Google Scholar, the analysis employs descriptive statistics, keyword clustering, and citation mapping to find the intellectual landscape of the field. Results show a dynamic, multidisciplinary domain with increasing attention to sustainability, environmental risks, and strategic integration across finance, operations, and infrastructure. Especially, under-researched conglomeration were identified in Legal Compliance and Health & Safety. While the study provides actionable insights for intellectuals and practitioners in risk management, it also provides the utility and limitations of applying scientometric methods to a concentrated applied domain. The findings contribute to both domain-specific knowledge and the broader scientometric discussion on mapping emerging, interdisciplinary research areas.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用科学计量学技术分析2015-2024年全球风险管理策略研究，识别主题结构、有影响力贡献者和研究空白。通过描述性统计、关键词聚类和引文映射发现该领域是多学科动态领域，重点关注可持续性、环境风险和跨领域战略整合，但法律合规与健康安全领域研究不足。
AI.research_question: 2015-2024年全球风险管理策略研究的主题结构、关键贡献者和研究空白是什么？

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于科学计量学理论，包括文献计量分析、引文分析和知识图谱理论。
AI.method: 使用Google Scholar等数据库的文献记录，采用描述性统计、关键词聚类分析和引文映射等科学计量学技术。
AI.findings: 风险管理是一个动态的多学科领域，日益关注可持续性和环境风险，在金融、运营和基础设施等领域存在战略整合。法律合规和健康安全领域存在研究空白。

title: Live Stream Selling and Pay-What-You-Want Tips
affiliations: Indiana University, Jiangsu Normal University and Indiana University, Bloomington

detail.title: Live Stream Selling and Pay-What-You-Want Tips
detail.abstract: Live streaming influencers entertain viewers with various content to receive tips while also promoting and selling products on behalf of firms to earn commissions. We model the microfoundation of viewers' joint tipping and buying decisions to expose unique viewer behaviors and the implications for influencers and firms. Interestingly, we show that rational viewers often make seemingly irrational and impulsive purchases. Driven by their excitement for the live streaming content, viewers buy products that they would not buy in stores. Furthermore, tipping and buying are substitutes (complements) for viewers with a low (high) valuation of the product. These viewer behaviors have important supply-side implications: First, selling products in live streams can reduce the influencer's tip income, and thus only influencers with enough viewership should sell products. Second, live streaming prices should be lower than prices in stores. Third, the firm's profit initially increases but eventually decreases with the number of viewers, indicating that selling through mega influencers can backfire. Lastly, the influencer can bargain for a lower price to increase tip income. Price bargaining benefits not only the influencer but also the firm and viewers, resulting in a win-win-win outcome. Empirical evidence gathered from the analysis of 1.3 million TikTok livestreaming sessions supports our theoretical findings.

AI.tldr: 本文通过建模直播观众的打赏和购买决策，揭示了看似非理性的冲动购买行为，发现打赏和购买存在替代/互补关系，并提出了对网红和企业的供应链启示，包括价格谈判带来的三赢结果。
AI.research_question: 直播网红同时接受打赏和销售产品时，观众的联合决策行为及其对网红和企业的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 直播电商的兴起使得网红同时通过内容娱乐获得打赏和通过产品销售获得佣金，需要理解观众在这种双重机制下的行为模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于微观经济学理论，建立观众打赏和购买决策的联合选择模型，分析观众效用最大化的行为模式。
AI.method: 理论建模分析观众决策行为，并通过130万场TikTok直播会话数据进行实证验证。
AI.findings: 1) 理性观众会做出看似非理性的冲动购买；2) 打赏和购买对低估值观众是替代品，对高估值观众是互补品；3) 销售产品可能减少打赏收入；4) 直播价格应低于门店价格；5) 超大网红可能适得其反；6) 价格谈判可实现三赢。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了直播电商中观众联合决策的理论框架，揭示了冲动购买的经济学解释，丰富了行为经济学和数字营销理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为网红提供产品选择策略，为企业制定定价和网红合作策略，为平台设计激励机制提供实践指导。

title: Validating Generative Agent-Based Models for Logistics and Supply Chain Management Research

detail.title: Validating Generative Agent-Based Models for Logistics and Supply Chain Management Research
detail.abstract: Generative Agent-Based Models (GABMs) powered by large language models (LLMs) offer promising potential for empirical logistics and supply chain management (LSCM) research by enabling realistic simulation of complex human behaviors. Unlike traditional agent-based models, GABMs generate human-like responses through natural language reasoning, which creates potential for new perspectives on emergent LSCM phenomena. However, the validity of LLMs as proxies for human behavior in LSCM simulations is unknown. This study evaluates LLM equivalence of human behavior through a controlled experiment examining dyadic customer-worker engagements in food delivery scenarios. I test six state-of-the-art LLMs against 957 human participants (477 dyads) using a moderated mediation design. This study reveals a need to validate GABMs on two levels: (1) human equivalence testing, and (2) decision process validation. Results reveal GABMs can effectively simulate human behaviors in LSCM; however, an equivalence-versus-process paradox emerges. While a series of Two One-Sided Tests (TOST) for equivalence reveals some LLMs demonstrate surface-level equivalence to humans, structural equation modeling (SEM) reveals artificial decision processes not present in human participants for some LLMs. These findings show GABMs as a potentially viable methodological instrument in LSCM with proper validation checks. The dual-validation framework also provides LSCM researchers with a guide to rigorous GABM development. For practitioners, this study offers evidence-based assessment for LLM selection for operational tasks.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估生成式智能体模型(GABMs)在物流供应链管理中的有效性，通过对比6个先进LLM与957名人类参与者在食品配送场景中的表现，发现需要双重验证：人类等效性测试和决策过程验证，揭示了表面等效性与决策过程差异的悖论。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型(LLMs)作为人类行为代理在物流供应链管理模拟中的有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 生成式智能体模型(GABMs)通过自然语言推理生成类人响应，为物流供应链管理研究提供了模拟复杂人类行为的新方法，但其作为人类行为代理的有效性尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于智能体建模理论，结合自然语言处理和人类行为模拟的理论框架，探讨LLMs在供应链情境中的人类行为等效性。
AI.method: 采用控制实验设计，在食品配送场景中对比6个先进LLM与957名人类参与者(477对)的表现，使用调节中介设计和结构方程建模进行分析。
AI.findings: GABMs能够有效模拟物流供应链管理中的人类行为，但存在等效性与过程的悖论：一些LLM在表面层次显示与人类等效，但在决策过程中显示出人类参与者不存在的人工决策模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了GABMs双重验证框架(人类等效性测试和决策过程验证)，为物流供应链管理研究提供了严谨的GABM开发指南。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实践者提供了基于证据的LLM选择评估，帮助选择适合运营任务的LLM模型，并提供了验证GABMs有效性的方法论工具。

detail.title: The Use of Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment (ИСПОЛЬЗОВАНИЕ ИСКУССТВЕННОГО ИНТЕЛЛЕКТА В РЕКРУТМЕНТЕ)

publicationDetails.detailsText: Искусственный и естественный интеллект

detail.abstract:
English abstract: The relevance of the research topic is due to the fact that artificial intelligence is being confidently introduced into the workplace. Artificial intelligence opens up new business opportunities for a company to support its internal business processes. The use of artificial intelligence in human resource management is part of the trend of introducing advanced technology in every management function. 

In this regard, the purpose of our research is to study the peculiarities of the use of artificial intelligence in the recruitment process and to identify trends and challenges associated with the introduction of this kind of technology in the management of the organisation. 

To achieve the goal, the following tasks were solved: study of the theoretical content of the concept of ‘artificial intelligence’ and its role in organisation recruitment; determination of the advantages of using artificial intelligence in the selection of necessary employees; analysis of current trends and identification of the main problems in the use of artificial intelligence in the system of personnel selection. Scientific publications of domestic and foreign scientists on the application of artificial intelligence in personnel management served as the information base of the study. The most important results of the work should include the analysis of current trends and problems in the introduction of artificial intelligence in the organization’s recruitment system.

Russian abstract: Актуальность темы исследования обусловлена тем, что искусственный интеллект уверенно внедряется на рабочие места. Искусственный интеллект открывает новые бизнес-возможности для компании с целью поддержки своих внутренних бизнес-процессов. Использование искусственного интеллекта в управлении персоналом является частью тенденции внедрения передовых технологий в каждую функцию управления, но современных научных исследований в этой области крайне мало. В связи с этим, целью нашего исследования является изучение особенностей использования искусственного интеллекта в процессе рекрутмента и выявление тенденций и проблем, связанных с внедрением такого рода технологии в управление организацией. Для достижения поставленной цели были решены следующие задачи: изучение теоретического содержания понятия «искусственный интеллект» и его роли в рекрутменте организации; определение преимуществ использования искусственного интеллекта в подборе необходимых сотрудников; анализ современных тенденций и выявление основных проблем при использовании искусственного интеллекта в системе отбора персонала. И
