title: Market Reactions in a Hidden Sector: The Impact of ESG Disasters on Logistics Companies
affiliations: University of Nottingham, Dublin City University  and University of Waikato

detail.title: Market Reactions in a Hidden Sector: The Impact of ESG Disasters on Logistics Companies
detail.abstract: This study investigates the impact of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) reputational disasters on the financial performance of publicly traded logistics corporations. Drawing on stakeholder and signalling theory, we explore the moderating impacts that the hidden nature of logistics activities, as well as signals regarding disaster severity, novelty, and corporate resilience, have on their financial performance. We utilise an extensive ESG event dataset from the RepRisk database and an Exponential GARCH (EGARCH) methodology to test our hypotheses. Our findings reveal that ESG disasters have a significant negative impact on the financial performance of logistics companies. However, impacts are generally short-lived and affect only logistics companies that are directly involved. This suggests that the hidden nature of logistics companies may be limiting the disciplinary power of stakeholder responses and raises questions about accountability in supply chains. Informing risk recovery strategies for logistics companies, results show that novel ESG disasters have a more immediate and pronounced negative impact; meanwhile, higher-severity disasters only amplify the negative financial impact in isolated cases. Smaller firms and firms with lower Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) performance are perceived to be less resilient to ESG disasters and are particularly vulnerable to negative investor reactions.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨ESG声誉灾难对上市物流公司财务绩效的影响，发现负面影响显著但短暂，仅直接影响涉事企业。物流活动的隐蔽性限制了利益相关者的监督效力，新颖ESG灾难影响更直接，而小企业和低CSR表现企业更易受负面投资者反应影响。
AI.research_question: ESG声誉灾难如何影响上市物流公司的财务绩效？物流活动的隐蔽性以及灾难严重性、新颖性和企业韧性信号在其中起什么调节作用？
AI.motivation: 物流行业在供应链中扮演关键角色但活动往往隐蔽，ESG问题日益重要，需要了解ESG灾难对物流企业财务的影响机制和边界条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于利益相关者理论和信号理论，分析ESG事件如何通过信号传递影响企业财务表现。
AI.method: 使用RepRisk数据库的ESG事件数据，采用指数GARCH（EGARCH）方法检验假设。
AI.findings: ESG灾难对物流公司财务绩效有显著负面影响但短暂，仅直接影响涉事企业；新颖ESG灾难影响更直接严重；高严重性灾难仅在个别情况下放大负面影响；小企业和低CSR表现企业韧性较差更易受负面投资者反应影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了利益相关者理论和信号理论在物流ESG背景下的应用，揭示了物流活动隐蔽性对问责机制的削弱作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为物流公司提供风险恢复策略指导，帮助识别最易受ESG灾难影响的脆弱企业类型，提升供应链问责意识。

detail.abstract: Purpose: Management departments are under pressure to improve student outcomes while cultivating modern, self-regulated learning habits. This paper investigates whether AI-powered study planners (e.g., AI assistants that generate weekly study plans, reminders, and task breakdowns) can improve time management and GPA among management undergraduates in Bangladesh. Design/Methodology/Approach: We design a quasi-experimental framework and demonstrate it using a simulated pilot dataset representing 200 second-year management students randomly assigned to a Control group (n=100) or an AI-Planner group (n=100) for 12 weeks. Core variables include baseline and follow-up GPA, weekly study hours, and time-management (TM) scores (0-100). The simulation draws on effect sizes suggested by recent literature to illustrate plausible outcomes and analysis steps. All raw data and code are provided for replication and classroom use. Findings (pilot simulation): The AI-Planner group shows a higher mean GPA gain than Control (+0.18 vs +0.06), larger improvement in TM score (+17.0 vs +4.6), and a gradual decrease in weekly study hours while maintaining higher academic performance-consistent with efficiency gains. Practical Implications: If confirmed with real data, low-cost AI planners could be integrated into management programs to support better pacing, reduce cramming, and enhance academic outcomes. Originality/Value: We provide (i) a ready-to-run research design for management educators in Bangladesh, (ii) open raw data and analysis assets, and (iii) a literature-grounded argument for piloting AI study-planner policies with strong ethical guardrails.

title: Unraveling Bank Risk and Sustainable Financial Stability Using SPRAF-Enhanced Z-Score Measures: A Case Study on Myanmar
affiliations: Independent, Lincoln University College and Lincoln University College

detail.title: Unraveling Bank Risk and Sustainable Financial Stability Using SPRAF-Enhanced Z-Score Measures: A Case Study on Myanmar
detail.abstract: Sustainable bank performance requires ongoing assessment of the risk and financial stability of the banks. A number of techniques have been introduced as an effort to advance this area. However, none of the techniques appear to be perfect as they fail to take a forward-looking approach in risk management, in particular during the times of institutional upheavals. Therefore, this study advocates a novel approach, i.e., SPRAF-enhanced Z-score framework, to analyze bank risk and long-term sustainable financial stability, using Myanmar as a case study. This approach offers insights into the predictions on the nature of short-term vulnerabilities of banks while ensuring to recognize their long-term resilience in structural financial mechanisms. By analyzing financial data from six banks during a period marked by sociopolitical upheaval (2018 to 2023), the findings provide sustainability-focused insights for policymakers and practitioners to strengthen banking stability over time. Adding sociopolitical factors as complex contexts makes the Z-score model stronger and gives us a more complete picture of how structural weaknesses affect things like profitability, leverage, and capital sufficiency. The results show that the amount of risk will change a lot over time, as shown by Return on Assets (ROA), Return on Equity (ROE), and Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR). This means that banks should use this useful method in their current risk assessment processes to help the conversation about financial resilience and give the world more information on how to keep banks stable when things are unstable.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种SPRAF增强的Z-score框架，用于分析银行风险和长期可持续金融稳定性，以缅甸为案例，通过纳入社会政治因素来改进传统风险评估方法。

AI.motivation: 现有风险评估技术缺乏前瞻性方法，特别是在制度动荡时期无法有效预测银行脆弱性和长期韧性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Z-score模型，通过纳入社会政治风险因素（SPRAF）来增强传统金融风险评估框架。
AI.method: 采用SPRAF增强的Z-score框架，分析缅甸6家银行在2018-2023年社会政治动荡期间的财务数据。
AI.findings: 风险水平随时间显著变化，ROA、ROE和CAR等指标显示银行风险具有动态性，社会政治因素对结构性弱点有重要影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将社会政治因素纳入传统金融风险评估的理论框架，丰富了银行稳定性评估的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和从业者提供了可持续性导向的见解，帮助加强银行业稳定性，特别是在不稳定环境下的银行风险管理。

detail.abstract:
This research paper is written by Yanke Dai (Shanghai University of International Business and Economics), Huasheng Gao (Fudan University), Na Li (Chinese University of Hong Kong), and Yujia Si (Fudan University).

This study examines the impact of patent collateralisation on entrepreneurship by exploiting policy changes in China that allow firms to use patents as collateral for financing. Our findings indicate that enhanced patent collateralisation significantly stimulates entrepreneurial startup activity, particularly within high-tech sectors. We identify three key channels through which this occurs: (1) facilitating access to debt and equity financing in the primary capital market; (2) enhancing liquidity in the secondary market for intellectual property; and (3) incentivising talented individuals to become entrepreneurs. Our findings highlight the economic benefits of patent collateralisation and its potential to foster the growth of high-tech startups.

detail.abstract: This article examines the Trump–Putin summit within the framework of the Third Generation in International Relations. It argues that Russia emerged as the primary strategic beneficiary, while Ukraine and Europe faced profound losses. The analysis highlights the exhaustion of Western sanctions, Ukraine’s flawed reliance on NATO and EU promises, and Europe’s revealed dependence on Washington. The article concludes that Russia converted battlefield resilience into political capital, whereas Ukraine was left burdened with debt, destruction, and human loss—an outcome reflecting the dangers of reckless leadership in the context of great-power rivalry.

title: Technological Distribution in Uganda: Information and Communications Technology and the State in an Eastern African Nation
affiliations: University of New Mexico - School of Law

detail.title: Technological Distribution in Uganda: Information and Communications Technology and the State in an Eastern African Nation
detail.abstract: Information and communications technologies (ICTs) include old technologies-such as the radio and the television-as well as newer technologies-such as the Internet and wireless telephony. This study considers the process that the government of Uganda has used to adopt and implement ICT policy. This study also considers the techniques which the government of Uganda has used to distribute ICTS in public locations such as government offices, schools, and hospitals. In particular, this study attempts to consider the political motivations for distribution. The Ugandan government's attempt to distribute this technology reflects strengths in the area of distribution of artefacts, particularly to rural areas. Information and communications technologies are an important part of the Ugandan economy. In addition, ICTs strengthen the ability of citizens to communicate with each other across regional and language borders through shared access points. Methodologically, this paper uses the case study method. Semi-structured interviews were conducted with politicians, policy makers, civil society activists, citizens, academics, medical personnel, regional government officials, and business people. This paper argues that politicians use ICTs as a component of a basket of goods and services that they can distribute to witnessing publics. This paper argues that ICT should be viewed as a type of infrastructure, and that as a public good, it can be used as a "club" good or "pork." Although several authors discuss the potential of ICTs as democratizing, this paper documents that the Ugandan government has employed ICTs in oppressive ways, including for the surveillance of opposition leaders, and for social control.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了乌干达政府采用和实施ICT政策的过程，重点关注政治动机和技术分配方式，发现政府将ICT作为政治工具用于监控和社会控制而非民主化。

AI.method: 案例研究方法，通过对政治家、政策制定者、公民社会活动家、公民、学者、医务人员、地区政府官员和商界人士进行半结构化访谈

AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了发展中国家ICT政策实施中的政治现实，为政策制定者和国际组织提供了重要警示

title: Connections Between Black Wall Street and Oklahoma's All-Black Connections Between Black Wall Street and Oklahoma's All-Black Towns Towns

detail.title: Connections Between Black Wall Street and Oklahoma's All-Black Connections Between Black Wall Street and Oklahoma's All-Black Towns Towns
detail.abstract:
On June 1, 1921, Black residents ran down Greenwood Avenue, the heart of Black Wall Street, in fear for their lives. The 1921 Tulsa Race Massacre is one of the worst acts of racial violence in United States History. Black Tulsans rushed out of burning buildings, dodging torched houses, machine gun fire, and makeshift turpentine bombs dropped from civilian airplanes. As they fled, they left behind what had been a bustling commercial district.

Many reports focus on the violence, arson, looting, and destruction of Greenwood. By contrast, this essay focuses on the impressive economic infrastructure that Freedmen in Tulsa built so painstakingly and racist Oklahomans so quickly destroyed. During the 1921 Tulsa Race Massacre, over thirty city blocks--housing over 1,000 residences and 600 successful businesses--were razed and burnt. In today's dollars, financial losses from the 1921 Tulsa Race Massacre totaled $26,752,705, but if one measures the loss of the ability to build wealth and pass it down to descendants, the 1921 Tulsa Race Massacre erased $610,743,750 in accumulated wealth At its height, Greenwood represented a vibrant community and a bustling, dense, and thriving commercial district with patrons of multiple ethnicities, races, and backgrounds. Tulsa was considered “The Negro Metropolis of the Southwest.” But for all its splendor, Tulsa was simply the largest of many thriving Black Oklahoma commercial communities; nationally, Black communities such as Richmond, Virginia; Birmingham, Alabama; and Durham, North Carolina similarly thrived. This essay explores the roots of Black commercial success in Oklahoma's All-Black towns.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文重点分析了1921年图尔萨种族大屠杀中被毁灭的黑人经济基础设施，探讨了绿物岛商业区作为"黑色增长带"的经济成就，以及这些经济资产消失对黑人资产积累和代际传承的深远影响。
AI.research_question: 为什么奥克拉赫马州的全黑人小镇能够建立起繁荣的商业社区？这些经济成就在1921年图尔萨种族大屠杀中被毁灭的经济成本有多大？
AI.motivation: 过去的研究多关注暴力事件本身，而本文强调需要重点研究黑人社区在图尔萨绿物岛建立起的继续经济基础设施和商业成就，以及这些资产消失对代际资产传承的长期影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资产积累理论、种族资本主义、空间经济学（黑人增长带概念）、代际资产传承理论
AI.method: 历史文档分析、经济数据重构、资产损失计算（包括直接财务损失和资产积累机会成本）、比较研穵600家成功企业的经济活动
AI.findings: 绿物岛商业区在被毁灭前包含1000多处住宅和600家成功企业，直接财务损失达到2600万美元（今天价值），而资产积累机会成本达6.1亿美元；这些社区是国家级别的黑人商业中心，吸引多种族族股业主
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了对空间经济学中"黑人增长带"概念的理论理解，提供了种族资本主义视角下资产消失的新分析框架，强调了经济基础设施建设对资产积累的关键作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为当今种族资本差距政策提供历史参考，帮助理解历史上种族暴力事件的长期经济影响，为资产赔偿讨论提供数据支撑

title: Vedic Diplomacy: Foundations in Hindu Thought and Its Relevance for Global Peace and Prosperity
affiliations: Nrisimha Dham

detail.title: Vedic Diplomacy: Foundations in Hindu Thought and Its Relevance for Global Peace and Prosperity
detail.abstract:
This book investigates the concept of Vedic diplomacy, a distinctive framework of statecraft rooted in the ethical and philosophical traditions of Hindu civilization. Moving beyond the confines of a single nation, it explores the broader South Asian context, integrating insights from Vedic scriptures, Puranic literature, and Kautilya’s Arthashastra. Through detailed textual analysis, historical case studies, and comparisons with modern international relations theories, the study reveals how Vedic diplomacy emphasizes dharma (moral duty), vasudhaiva kutumbakam (universal kinship), and a graduated strategy of conflict resolution encompassing conciliation, inducement, division, and force.

The book further examines the contemporary relevance of these principles for promoting ethical governance, intercultural understanding, and sustainable global peace. It critically assesses the prospects and challenges of reviving Vedic diplomacy in the modern world, proposing practical strategies for integration into diplomatic education, policy-making, and regional cooperation. Ultimately, this work argues that re-engaging with Vedic diplomatic traditions offers a transformative vision for a more just, peaceful, and prosperous international order.

AI.tldr: 本书探讨吠陀外交概念，这是一种根植于印度教文明伦理哲学传统的独特治国方略框架。通过文本分析、历史案例和现代国际关系理论比较，揭示吠陀外交强调道德责任、世界一家理念以及包含调解、诱导、分化和武力的渐进式冲突解决策略。

title: Surviving the Megadrought
affiliations: University of New Mexico - School of Law

detail.title: Surviving the Megadrought
detail.abstract:
In the town of Rio Verde Foothills, a quarter of the houses rely on water hauled into the town by trucks because local wells are increasingly going dry because of a rapidly falling water table. Springs in the Amargosa Basin are drying up, threatening humans as well as plants, amphibians, and mammals “that live nowhere else on the planet.” And the surface area of the Great Salt Lake has shrunk from 3,300 square miles to fewer than 1,000 square miles over the last three decades. 

These outcomes are some of the symptoms of the current megadrought in southwestern North America. The megadrought has reduced snowpack, diminished river flow, and lowered lake levels in many western states in the past two decades. Other effects of the megadrought include forest stress and increased wildfire activity. This current megadrought rivals dry periods last seen five hundred years ago and, importantly, has resulted in part from human-caused climate change. Among the most serious effects of rapidly changing climatic conditions are the dramatic challenges of groundwater management in the desert Southwest.

AI.tldr: 北美西南部特大干旱导致严重水资源危机，包括地下水枯竭、湖泊萎缩、生态系统威胁和野火增加，部分由人为气候变化引起

AI.theoretical_framework: 水资源管理理论、气候变化影响理论、干旱生态学理论

AI.findings: 1)地下水水位快速下降导致水井干涸；2)泉水干涸威胁特有物种生存；3)湖泊面积大幅萎缩；4)积雪减少和河流流量下降；5)森林压力和野火活动增加
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了人为气候变化对特大干旱的贡献机制，完善了干旱对水资源系统影响的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为西南沙漠地区地下水管理提供预警和决策支持，有助于制定应对水资源危机的适应性策略
